-    "Yes, your math and approach make sense!\n",
-    "\n",
-    "**Ring sizes:**\n",
-    "- Ring 0: 1 hex (center)\n",
-    "- Ring 1: 6 hexes\n",
-    "- Ring 2: 12 hexes\n",
-    "- Ring N: 6×N hexes (for N > 0)\n",
-    "- Total for N rings: 1 + 3×N×(N+1)\n",
-    "\n",
-    "**Corners and edges:** Exactly right - corners are at `N × pure_direction` (e.g., `6 × HexPosition.E` for ring 6 east corner), and edges interpolate between adjacent corners.\n",
-    "\n",
-    "**The \"over-fetch and filter\" approach:**\n",
-    "\n",
-    "```\n",
-    "1. Define target rectangle (in world hex coords)\n",
-    "2. Find which chunks intersect that rect\n",
-    "3. Generate/load those chunks (will include extras)\n",
-    "4. Create output grid sized to rect\n",
-    "5. For each hex in output grid:\n",
-    "   - Find which chunk contains it\n",
-    "   - Copy elevation from chunk\n",
-    "   - Skip if no chunk covers it (or fill from coarse)\n",
-    "```\n",
-    "\n",
-    "This is cleaner than trying to perfectly tile hex-shaped chunks into a rect. You accept the geometric mismatch and just filter at the end.\n",

+    "def find_coastal_chunks(gen, coarse, max_ring=2):\n",
+    "    \"\"\"Find chunks that contain both land and ocean.\"\"\"\n",

+    "        has_land = has_ocean = False\n",
+    "        for ring in range(3):\n",
+    "            positions = [HexPosition(coarse_q, coarse_r, coarse_s)] if ring == 0 else \\\n",
+    "                        HexPosition(coarse_q, coarse_r, coarse_s).ring(ring)\n",
+    "            for pos in positions:\n",
+    "                idx = coarse.hexGrid.hexposition_to_index(pos, origin_index=coarse.hexGrid.midpoint)\n",
+    "                if 0 <= idx < len(coarse.elevations):\n",
+    "                    if coarse.elevations[idx] > 0: has_land = True\n",
+    "                    else: has_ocean = True\n",
+    "        \n",
+    "        if has_land and has_ocean:\n",
+    "            coastal.append((i, chunk_ref))\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    return all_chunks, coastal\n",
+    "\n",
+    "\n",
+    "def render_global_map(gen, coarse, all_chunks, coastal_chunks):\n",
+    "    \"\"\"Render coarse map with chunk locations marked.\"\"\"\n",
+    "    coarse.hexGrid.adjustRadius(12)\n",
+    "    coarse.colorMap()\n",
+    "    coarse.hexGrid.update()\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    textStyle = StyleCSS(\"textStyle\", fill=\"white\", font_size=\"1.5em\", \n",
+    "                         filter=\"drop-shadow(3px 3px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.7))\")\n",
+    "    coarse.hexGrid.builder.add_style(textStyle)\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    chunk_overlay = \"\"\n",
+    "    coastal_indices = {ci for ci, _ in coastal_chunks}\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    for i, chunk_ref in enumerate(all_chunks):\n",
+    "        center = chunk_ref.center_hex\n",
+    "        coarse_q = int(round(center.q / gen.scale))\n",
+    "        coarse_r = int(round(center.r / gen.scale))\n",
+    "        coarse_s = -coarse_q - coarse_r\n",
+    "        coarse_pos = HexPosition(coarse_q, coarse_r, coarse_s)\n",
+    "        coarse_idx = coarse.hexGrid.hexposition_to_index(coarse_pos, origin_index=coarse.hexGrid.midpoint)\n",

+    "            fill = \"rgba(0,255,0,0.2)\" if is_coastal else \"none\"\n",
+    "            chunk_overlay += f'<circle cx=\"{hex_obj.center.x}\" cy=\"{hex_obj.center.y}\" r=\"10\" fill=\"{fill}\" stroke=\"{color}\" stroke-width=\"2\"/>\\n'\n",
+    "            chunk_overlay += f'<text x=\"{hex_obj.center.x}\" y=\"{hex_obj.center.y + 4}\" text-anchor=\"middle\" fill=\"white\" font-size=\"8\" font-weight=\"bold\">{i}</text>\\n'\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    coarse.hexGrid.builder.adjust(\"chunks\", chunk_overlay)\n",
+    "    coarse.hexGrid.builder.add_centered_text(\"Global View - Coastal chunks in green\", \n",
+    "        y_offset=-coarse.hexGrid.builder.height/2 + 30, class_name=textStyle.name)\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    return coarse.hexGrid.builder\n",

+    "def render_detail_with_overlaps(gen, coarse, selected_chunks):\n",
+    "    \"\"\"Render detailed view showing cores and halo overlaps.\"\"\"\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    # Generate chunks and collect positions\n",
+    "    chunks_data = []\n",
+    "    all_core_positions = []\n",
+    "    all_halo_positions = []\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    for global_idx, chunk_ref in selected_chunks:\n",
+    "        chunk = gen.generate_chunk(chunk_ref)\n",
+    "        core_positions = [chunk.index_to_world(idx) for idx in chunk.iter_core()]\n",
+    "        halo_positions = [chunk.index_to_world(idx) for idx in chunk.iter_halo()]\n",
+    "        chunks_data.append((global_idx, chunk_ref, chunk, core_positions, halo_positions))\n",
+    "        all_core_positions.extend(core_positions)\n",
+    "        all_halo_positions.extend(halo_positions)\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    # Calculate bounds including halo\n",
+    "    all_pos = all_core_positions + all_halo_positions\n",
+    "    qs = [p.q for p in all_pos]\n",
+    "    rs = [p.r for p in all_pos]\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    pad = 3\n",
+    "    min_q, max_q = min(qs) - pad, max(qs) + pad\n",
+    "    min_r, max_r = min(rs) - pad, max(rs) + pad\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    # Generate detailed terrain\n",
+    "    detail = gen.rect_region_from_chunks(min_q, max_q, min_r, max_r)\n",
+    "    detail.hexGrid.update()\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    origin_world = HexPosition(min_q, min_r, -min_q - min_r)\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    # Build index sets for each chunk's core and halo\n",
+    "    chunk_cores = {}    # global_idx -> set of grid indices\n",
+    "    chunk_halos = {}    # global_idx -> set of grid indices\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    for global_idx, chunk_ref, chunk, core_positions, halo_positions in chunks_data:\n",
+    "        core_indices = set()\n",
+    "        for world_pos in core_positions:\n",
+    "            local_pos = world_pos - origin_world\n",
+    "            grid_idx = detail.hexGrid.hexposition_to_index(local_pos, origin_index=0)\n",
+    "            if 0 <= grid_idx < len(detail.hexGrid.hexes):\n",
+    "                core_indices.add(grid_idx)\n",
+    "        chunk_cores[global_idx] = core_indices\n",
+    "        \n",
+    "        halo_indices = set()\n",
+    "        for world_pos in halo_positions:\n",
+    "            local_pos = world_pos - origin_world\n",
+    "            grid_idx = detail.hexGrid.hexposition_to_index(local_pos, origin_index=0)\n",
+    "            if 0 <= grid_idx < len(detail.hexGrid.hexes):\n",
+    "                halo_indices.add(grid_idx)\n",
+    "        chunk_halos[global_idx] = halo_indices\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    # Calculate overlaps\n",
+    "    all_halo_indices = set()\n",
+    "    for indices in chunk_halos.values():\n",
+    "        all_halo_indices |= indices\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    all_core_indices = set()\n",
+    "    for indices in chunk_cores.values():\n",
+    "        all_core_indices |= indices\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    # Halo-only (not in any core)\n",
+    "    halo_only = all_halo_indices - all_core_indices\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    # Find overlapping halo regions (in 2+ halos)\n",
+    "    from collections import Counter\n",
+    "    halo_counts = Counter()\n",
+    "    for indices in chunk_halos.values():\n",
+    "        for idx in indices:\n",
+    "            halo_counts[idx] += 1\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    # Indices in multiple halos (overlap zone)\n",
+    "    overlap_indices = {idx for idx, count in halo_counts.items() if count >= 2}\n",
+    "    overlap_in_halo_only = overlap_indices & halo_only\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    # Styles\n",
+    "    chunk_styles = StyleCSS.seaborn(\"Set2\", len(chunks_data))\n",
+    "    textStyle = StyleCSS(\"textStyle\", fill=\"white\", font_size=\"1.5em\", \n",
+    "                         filter=\"drop-shadow(3px 3px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.7))\")\n",
+    "    detail.hexGrid.builder.add_style(textStyle)\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    region_overlay = \"\"\n",
+    "    legend_styles = []\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    # 1. Draw overlap region first (underneath everything)\n",
+    "    if overlap_in_halo_only:\n",
+    "        overlap_region = HexRegion(hexes=overlap_in_halo_only, hexGrid=detail.hexGrid)\n",
+    "        overlap_style = StyleCSS(\n",
+    "            \"Halo_Overlap\",\n",
+    "            fill=\"#ff00ff\",  # Magenta for visibility\n",
+    "            stroke=\"#ff00ff\",\n",
+    "            stroke_width=2,\n",
+    "            opacity=0.25\n",
+    "        )\n",
+    "        detail.hexGrid.builder.add_style(overlap_style)\n",
+    "        region_overlay += overlap_region.draw(style=overlap_style, f=unique_windy_edge(), inset=0.9)\n",
+    "        legend_styles.append(overlap_style.copy(\"Halo_Overlap\"))\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    # 2. Draw individual halo boundaries (dashed, no fill)\n",
+    "    for i, (global_idx, chunk_ref, chunk, core_positions, halo_positions) in enumerate(chunks_data):\n",
+    "        base_color = chunk_styles[i].properties['fill']\n",
+    "        halo_indices = chunk_halos[global_idx]\n",
+    "        \n",
+    "        if halo_indices:\n",
+    "            halo_region = HexRegion(hexes=halo_indices, hexGrid=detail.hexGrid)\n",
+    "            halo_style = StyleCSS(\n",
+    "                f\"Halo_{global_idx}\",\n",
+    "                fill=\"none\",\n",
+    "                stroke=base_color,\n",
+    "                stroke_width=3,\n",
+    "                stroke_dasharray=\"8,4\",\n",
+    "                opacity=0.7\n",
+    "            )\n",
+    "            detail.hexGrid.builder.add_style(halo_style)\n",
+    "            region_overlay += halo_region.draw(style=halo_style, f=unique_windy_edge(), inset=0.98)\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    # 3. Draw cores on top\n",
+    "    for i, (global_idx, chunk_ref, chunk, core_positions, halo_positions) in enumerate(chunks_data):\n",
+    "        base_color = chunk_styles[i].properties['fill']\n",
+    "        core_indices = chunk_cores[global_idx]\n",
+    "        \n",
+    "        if core_indices:\n",
+    "            core_region = HexRegion(hexes=core_indices, hexGrid=detail.hexGrid)\n",
+    "            core_style = StyleCSS(\n",
+    "                f\"Core_{global_idx}\",\n",
+    "                fill=base_color,\n",
+    "                stroke=base_color,\n",
+    "                stroke_width=3,\n",
+    "                opacity=0.35\n",
+    "            )\n",
+    "            detail.hexGrid.builder.add_style(core_style)\n",
+    "            region_overlay += core_region.draw(style=core_style, f=unique_windy_edge(), inset=0.95)\n",
+    "            legend_styles.append(core_style.copy(f\"Chunk_{global_idx}\"))\n",
+    "            \n",
+    "            # Label at centroid\n",
+    "            centroid_idx = core_region.centroid_hex()\n",
+    "            if centroid_idx and 0 <= centroid_idx < len(detail.hexGrid.hexes):\n",
+    "                cx = detail.hexGrid.hexes[centroid_idx].center.x\n",
+    "                cy = detail.hexGrid.hexes[centroid_idx].center.y\n",
+    "                region_overlay += f'<text x=\"{cx}\" y=\"{cy}\" text-anchor=\"middle\" fill=\"white\" font-size=\"14\" font-weight=\"bold\" style=\"filter: drop-shadow(2px 2px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.8))\">Chunk {global_idx}</text>\\n'\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    detail.hexGrid.builder.adjust(\"chunk_regions\", region_overlay)\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    # Add legend\n",
+    "    keyLabelStyle = StyleCSS(\"keyLabel\", fill=\"#333\", font_size=\"12px\")\n",
+    "    detail.hexGrid.builder.add_style(keyLabelStyle)\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    for style in legend_styles:\n",
+    "        style.properties['opacity'] = '1.0'\n",
+    "        detail.hexGrid.builder.add_style(style)\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    legend_svg = detail.hexGrid.builder.legendBelow(legend_styles, gap=15, bg_fill=\"rgba(255,255,255,0.9)\")\n",
+    "    detail.hexGrid.builder.adjust(\"legend\", legend_svg)\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    detail.hexGrid.builder.add_style(textStyle)\n",
+    "    detail.hexGrid.builder.add_centered_text(\"Chunk Cores + Halo Overlaps (magenta)\", \n",
+    "        y_offset=-detail.hexGrid.builder.height/2 + 50, class_name=textStyle.name)\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    return detail.hexGrid.builder, chunks_data\n",

+    "def visualize_overlap_interpolation(gen, coarse, selected_chunks, zoom_padding=2):\n",
+    "    \"\"\"Zoom into overlap zone and show chunk influence with gradient patterns.\"\"\"\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    # Generate chunks\n",
+    "    chunks_data = []\n",
+    "    for global_idx, chunk_ref in selected_chunks:\n",
+    "        chunk = gen.generate_chunk(chunk_ref)\n",
+    "        chunks_data.append((global_idx, chunk_ref, chunk))\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    # Find overlap positions (in 2+ chunk halos)\n",
+    "    position_chunks = {}  # world_pos -> list of (global_idx, chunk, local_idx)\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    for global_idx, chunk_ref, chunk in chunks_data:\n",
+    "        for idx in chunk.iter_all():\n",
+    "            world_pos = chunk.index_to_world(idx)\n",
+    "            if world_pos not in position_chunks:\n",
+    "                position_chunks[world_pos] = []\n",
+    "            position_chunks[world_pos].append((global_idx, chunk, idx))\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    overlap_positions = {pos for pos, chunks in position_chunks.items() if len(chunks) >= 2}\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    if not overlap_positions:\n",
+    "        print(\"No overlap found!\")\n",
+    "        return None\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    # Bounds around overlap\n",
+    "    qs = [p.q for p in overlap_positions]\n",
+    "    rs = [p.r for p in overlap_positions]\n",
+    "    min_q, max_q = min(qs) - zoom_padding, max(qs) + zoom_padding\n",
+    "    min_r, max_r = min(rs) - zoom_padding, max(rs) + zoom_padding\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    nrows = max_r - min_r + 1\n",
+    "    ncols = max_q - min_q + 1\n",
+    "    grid = HexGrid(nRows=nrows, nCols=ncols, radius=gen.fine_radius * 2, style=coarse.seaLevel)\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    origin_world = HexPosition(min_q, min_r, -min_q - min_r)\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    # Chunk colors\n",
+    "    chunk_colors = {}\n",
+    "    chunk_styles = StyleCSS.seaborn(\"Set2\", len(chunks_data))\n",
+    "    for i, (global_idx, _, _) in enumerate(chunks_data):\n",
+    "        chunk_colors[global_idx] = chunk_styles[i].properties['fill']\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    # Create patterns for each chunk at different densities\n",
+    "    patternGen = TerrainPatterns(coarse)\n",
+    "    density_levels = 6\n",
+    "    chunk_patterns = {}  # (global_idx, level) -> pattern\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    for i, (global_idx, _, _) in enumerate(chunks_data):\n",
+    "        color = chunk_colors[global_idx]\n",
+    "        patterns = patternGen.ballDensity(\n",
+    "            levels=density_levels,\n",
+    "            fills=[color],\n",
+    "            prefix=f\"chunk_{global_idx}\"\n",
+    "        )\n",
+    "        for level, pattern in enumerate(patterns):\n",
+    "            chunk_patterns[(global_idx, level)] = pattern\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    # Build SVG\n",
+    "    builder = SVGBuilder()\n",
+    "    builder.width = grid.builder.width\n",
+    "    builder.height = grid.builder.height\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    # Add terrain styles\n",
+    "    for style in StyleCSS.elevations():\n",
+    "        builder.add_style(style)\n",
+    "    builder.add_style(coarse.seaLevel)\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    # Add all patterns to builder\n",
+    "    for pattern in chunk_patterns.values():\n",
+    "        builder.add_definition(pattern)\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    # First pass: base terrain\n",
+    "    terrain_svg = \"\"\n",
+    "    for grid_idx in range(len(grid.hexes)):\n",
+    "        local_pos = grid.index_to_hexposition(grid_idx, origin_index=0)\n",
+    "        world_pos = origin_world + local_pos\n",
+    "        hex_obj = grid.hexes[grid_idx]\n",
+    "        \n",
+    "        elev = 0\n",
+    "        if world_pos in position_chunks:\n",
+    "            _, chunk, chunk_idx = position_chunks[world_pos][0]\n",
+    "            elev = chunk.elevations[chunk_idx]\n",
+    "        \n",
+    "        level = int(elev / coarse.elevationDelta)\n",
+    "        level = max(0, min(level, len(StyleCSS.elevations()) - 1))\n",
+    "        style = coarse.seaLevel if elev <= 0 else StyleCSS.elevations()[level]\n",
+    "        hex_obj.style = style\n",
+    "        terrain_svg += \"\\t\" + hex_obj.svg() + \"\\n\"\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    builder.adjust(\"terrain\", terrain_svg)\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    # Second pass: overlay with influence patterns - NO OPACITY\n",
+    "    overlay_svg = \"\"\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    for grid_idx in range(len(grid.hexes)):\n",
+    "        local_pos = grid.index_to_hexposition(grid_idx, origin_index=0)\n",
+    "        world_pos = origin_world + local_pos\n",
+    "        hex_obj = grid.hexes[grid_idx]\n",
+    "        \n",
+    "        if world_pos not in position_chunks:\n",
+    "            continue\n",
+    "        \n",
+    "        covering_chunks = position_chunks[world_pos]\n",
+    "        \n",
+    "        # Calculate influence (inverse distance) for each chunk\n",
+    "        influences = []\n",
+    "        for global_idx, chunk, _ in covering_chunks:\n",
+    "            chunk_center = chunk.center_world\n",
+    "            dist = world_pos.distance(chunk_center)\n",
+    "            max_dist = gen.chunk_rings + gen.halo_rings\n",
+    "            # Influence: 1.0 at center, 0.0 at edge of halo\n",
+    "            influence = max(0, 1.0 - dist / max_dist)\n",
+    "            influences.append((global_idx, influence))\n",
+    "        \n",

+    "        for global_idx, influence in influences:\n",

+    "                level = int(influence * (density_levels - 1))\n",
+    "                level = min(level, density_levels - 1)\n",
+    "                \n",
+    "                pattern_key = (global_idx, level)\n",
+    "                if pattern_key in chunk_patterns:\n",
+    "                    pat_id = chunk_patterns[pattern_key].attributes['id']\n",
+    "                    \n",
+    "                    points = \" \".join(f\"{v.x},{v.y}\" for v in hex_obj.v)\n",
+    "                    # NO OPACITY - dots are solid, blending happens via overlap\n",
+    "                    overlay_svg += f'<polygon points=\"{points}\" fill=\"url(#{pat_id})\"/>\\n'\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    builder.adjust(\"influence\", overlay_svg)\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    # Add chunk center markers\n",
+    "    markers_svg = \"\"\n",
+    "    for global_idx, chunk_ref, chunk in chunks_data:\n",
+    "        chunk_center = chunk.center_world\n",
+    "        local_center = chunk_center - origin_world\n",
+    "        center_idx = grid.hexposition_to_index(local_center, origin_index=0)\n",
+    "        \n",
+    "        if 0 <= center_idx < len(grid.hexes):\n",
+    "            hex_obj = grid.hexes[center_idx]\n",
+    "            color = chunk_colors[global_idx]\n",
+    "            markers_svg += f'<circle cx=\"{hex_obj.center.x}\" cy=\"{hex_obj.center.y}\" r=\"15\" fill=\"{color}\" stroke=\"white\" stroke-width=\"3\"/>\\n'\n",
+    "            markers_svg += f'<text x=\"{hex_obj.center.x}\" y=\"{hex_obj.center.y + 5}\" text-anchor=\"middle\" fill=\"white\" font-size=\"12\" font-weight=\"bold\">{global_idx}</text>\\n'\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    builder.adjust(\"markers\", markers_svg)\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    # Title\n",
+    "    textStyle = StyleCSS(\"textStyle\", fill=\"#333\", font_size=\"14px\")\n",
+    "    builder.add_style(textStyle)\n",
+    "    builder.add_centered_text(\n",
+    "        \"Overlap Zone - Dot density shows chunk influence (denser = stronger)\",\n",
+    "        y_offset=-builder.height/2 + 25,\n",
+    "        class_name=textStyle.name\n",
+    "    )\n",
+    "    \n",
+    "    # Legend\n",
+    "    legend_styles = []\n",

+      "class DrainageBasins:\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "    def __init__(self,terrain: Terrain,debug=False):\r\n",
+      "        self.terrain = terrain\r\n",
+      "        self.sheds = Watershed.compute_all(terrain,debug=debug)\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "    @staticmethod\r\n",
+      "    def decode(s: str, terrain: Terrain, system: SoilSystem = None) -> 'DrainageBasins':\r\n",
+      "        \"\"\"Decode DrainageBasins from string format.\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "        lines = s.strip().split('\\n')\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        sheds = []\r\n",
+      "        watershed_lines = []\r\n",
+      "        in_watershed = False\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        for line in lines:\r\n",
+      "            if in_watershed:\r\n",
+      "                if line.startswith('-watershed:'):\r\n",
+      "                    # Decode accumulated watershed\r\n",
+      "                    shed = Watershed.decode('\\n'.join(watershed_lines), terrain, system)\r\n",
+      "                    sheds.append(shed)\r\n",
+      "                    watershed_lines = []\r\n",
+      "                    in_watershed = False\r\n",
+      "                else:\r\n",
+      "                    watershed_lines.append(line)\r\n",
+      "            elif line.startswith('+watershed:'):\r\n",
+      "                in_watershed = True\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Create DrainageBasins without recomputing\r\n",
+      "        basins = object.__new__(DrainageBasins)\r\n",
+      "        basins.terrain = terrain\r\n",
+      "        basins.sheds = sheds\r\n",
+      "        return basins\r\n",

+      "def encode(self: DrainageBasins) -> str:\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Encode DrainageBasins to string format.\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    lines = []\r\n",
+      "    lines.append(f\"count:{len(self.sheds)}\")\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    for i, shed in enumerate(self.sheds):\r\n",
+      "        lines.append(f\"+watershed:{i}\")\r\n",
+      "        lines.append(shed.encode())\r\n",
+      "        lines.append(f\"-watershed:{i}\")\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    return '\\n'.join(lines)\r\n",

+      "# %% ../../nbs/water/basin.ipynb #af7641b7\r\n",
+      "@patch\r\n",
+      "def select_shed(self: DrainageBasins, \r\n",
+      "                                    min_flow: int = 10,\r\n",
+      "                                    max_rivers: int = 20,\r\n",
+      "                                    min_length: int = 5) -> List[Watershed]:\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Select the most important rivers to display.\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Strategy:\r\n",
+      "    1. One main river per major watershed (largest basins)\r\n",
+      "    2. Rivers must have significant flow (min_flow)\r\n",
+      "    3. Rivers must be long enough to be visible (min_length)\r\n",
+      "    4. Prioritize by watershed size and flow\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Args:\r\n",
+      "        min_flow: Minimum accumulated flow to show\r\n",
+      "        max_rivers: Maximum number of rivers to return\r\n",
+      "        min_length: Minimum number of hexes in river path\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Returns:\r\n",
+      "        List of River objects suitable for display\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    candidates = []\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    for watershed in self.sheds:\r\n",
+      "        river = watershed.tributary\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Calculate river metrics\r\n",
+      "        flow_values = river._calculate_flow()\r\n",
+      "        max_flow = max(flow_values.values()) if flow_values else 0\r\n",
+      "        river_length = len(river.hexes)\r\n",
+      "        watershed_size = len(watershed.region.hexes)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Score = combination of flow, length, and watershed size\r\n",
+      "        score = max_flow * 0.5 + river_length * 0.3 + watershed_size * 0.2\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Filter by minimum criteria\r\n",
+      "        if max_flow >= min_flow and river_length >= min_length:\r\n",
+      "            candidates.append((watershed, score, max_flow, river_length))\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Sort by score descending\r\n",
+      "    candidates.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Return top N watershed\r\n",
+      "    return [watershed for watershed, _, _, _ in candidates[:max_rivers]]\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "\r\n",

+      "        max_rivers=top_n,\r\n",
+      "        min_length=3\r\n",

+      "# %% ../../nbs/water/basin.ipynb #a35a6653\r\n",
+      "@patch\r\n",
+      "def build_fans_and_deltas(self: DrainageBasins,\r\n",
+      "                          top_n: int = 8,\r\n",
+      "                          build_fans: bool = True,\r\n",
+      "                          build_deltas: bool = True,\r\n",
+      "                          debug: bool = False):\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Build alluvial fans and deltas for major watersheds.\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Returns dict with 'fans' and 'deltas' keys containing HexRegion lists.\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"\r\n",

+      "# %% ../../nbs/water/basin.ipynb #2c9d1041\r\n",
+      "@patch\r\n",
+      "def gradient_overlay(self: DrainageBasins,\r\n",
+      "                     min_width: float = 0.5,\r\n",
+      "                     max_width: float = 4.0,\r\n",
+      "                     opacity: float = 0.6):\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Create overlay showing flow direction with gradient-based line widths.\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Each line segment:\r\n",
+      "    - Connects a land hex to its downhill neighbor\r\n",
+      "    - Colored by watershed\r\n",
+      "    - Width scaled by elevation gradient (steeper = thicker)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Args:\r\n",
+      "        min_width: Minimum line width (for flat areas)\r\n",
+      "        max_width: Maximum line width (for steep slopes)\r\n",
+      "        opacity: Line opacity (0-1)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Returns:\r\n",
+      "        SVG string of line segments\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    terrain = self.terrain\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # First pass: calculate all gradients to find max for normalization\r\n",
+      "    gradients = []\r\n",
+      "    flow_data = []  # Store (hex_idx, neighbor_idx, gradient, watershed_idx)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Map each hex to its watershed\r\n",
+      "    hex_to_watershed = {}\r\n",
+      "    for i, watershed in enumerate(self.sheds):\r\n",
+      "        for hex_idx in watershed.region.hexes:\r\n",
+      "            hex_to_watershed[hex_idx] = i\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    for hex_idx in hex_to_watershed.keys():\r\n",
+      "        # Find lowest neighbor (flow direction)\r\n",
+      "        lowest = terrain.lowest_neighbor(hex_idx)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        if lowest is None or terrain.elevations[lowest] <= 0:\r\n",
+      "            continue  # Skip if no downhill or flows to ocean\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Calculate gradient\r\n",
+      "        elev_current = terrain.elevations[hex_idx]\r\n",
+      "        elev_next = terrain.elevations[lowest]\r\n",
+      "        elev_drop = elev_current - elev_next\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Distance between hex centers\r\n",
+      "        hex_obj = terrain.hexGrid.hexes[hex_idx]\r\n",
+      "        neighbor_obj = terrain.hexGrid.hexes[lowest]\r\n",
+      "        distance = hex_obj.center.distance(neighbor_obj.center)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        gradient = elev_drop / distance if distance > 0 else 0\r\n",
+      "        gradients.append(gradient)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        watershed_idx = hex_to_watershed[hex_idx]\r\n",
+      "        flow_data.append((hex_idx, lowest, gradient, watershed_idx))\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Find max gradient for normalization\r\n",
+      "    max_gradient = max(gradients) if gradients else 1.0\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Second pass: generate SVG lines\r\n",
+      "    overlay = \"\"\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Create styles for each watershed with opacity\r\n",
+      "    for i, watershed in enumerate(self.sheds):\r\n",
+      "        # Create a modified style with opacity for lines\r\n",
+      "        line_style = StyleCSS(\r\n",
+      "            f\"{watershed.style.name}_flow\",\r\n",
+      "            stroke=watershed.style.properties.get('fill', '#000000'),\r\n",
+      "            fill=\"none\",\r\n",
+      "            opacity=opacity,\r\n",
+      "            stroke_linecap=\"round\"\r\n",
+      "        )\r\n",
+      "        terrain.hexGrid.builder.add_style(line_style)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Generate line segments\r\n",
+      "    for hex_idx, neighbor_idx, gradient, watershed_idx in flow_data:\r\n",
+      "        # Normalize gradient and calculate width\r\n",
+      "        normalized = gradient / max_gradient if max_gradient > 0 else 0\r\n",
+      "        width = min_width + normalized * (max_width - min_width)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Get hex centers\r\n",
+      "        hex_obj = terrain.hexGrid.hexes[hex_idx]\r\n",
+      "        neighbor_obj = terrain.hexGrid.hexes[neighbor_idx]\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Get watershed style\r\n",
+      "        watershed = self.sheds[watershed_idx]\r\n",
+      "        style_name = f\"{watershed.style.name}_flow\"\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Create line segment\r\n",
+      "        overlay += (\r\n",
+      "            f'\\t<line '\r\n",
+      "            f'x1=\"{hex_obj.center.x:.1f}\" '\r\n",
+      "            f'y1=\"{hex_obj.center.y:.1f}\" '\r\n",
+      "            f'x2=\"{neighbor_obj.center.x:.1f}\" '\r\n",
+      "            f'y2=\"{neighbor_obj.center.y:.1f}\" '\r\n",
+      "            f'class=\"{style_name}\" '\r\n",
+      "            f'stroke-width=\"{width:.2f}\" '\r\n",
+      "            f'/>\\n'\r\n",
+      "        )\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    return overlay\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "# %% ../../nbs/water/basin.ipynb #dd7c3ac7\r\n",
+      "@patch\r\n",
+      "def dotted_watershed_overlay(self: DrainageBasins, \r\n",
+      "                              flow_levels: int = 5,\r\n",
+      "                              min_density: float = 0.25,  # NEW: minimum dot density\r\n",
+      "                              debug: bool = False) -> str:\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Create dotted watershed overlay where dot density represents flow accumulation.\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Args:\r\n",
+      "        flow_levels: Number of dot density levels (default 5)\r\n",
+      "        min_density: Minimum density for low-flow areas (0.25 = 25%)\r\n",
+      "        debug: Print pattern generation info\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Returns:\r\n",
+      "        SVG string for the overlay\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    terrain = self.terrain\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Ensure we have flow data\r\n",
+      "    if 'flow' not in terrain.fields:\r\n",
+      "        all_flows = {}\r\n",
+      "        for watershed in self.sheds:\r\n",
+      "            river_flow = watershed.tributary._calculate_flow()\r\n",
+      "            for hex_idx, flow_count in river_flow.items():\r\n",
+      "                all_flows[hex_idx] = all_flows.get(hex_idx, 0) + flow_count\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        terrain.fields['flow'] = np.zeros(len(terrain.elevations))\r\n",
+      "        for hex_idx, flow in all_flows.items():\r\n",
+      "            terrain.fields['flow'][hex_idx] = flow\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    flow_data = terrain.fields['flow']\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Generate patterns for each watershed\r\n",
+      "    patternGen = TerrainPatterns(terrain)\r\n",
+      "    all_patterns = []\r\n",
+      "    watershed_to_patterns = {}\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    for i, watershed in enumerate(self.sheds):\r\n",
+      "        color = watershed.style.properties.get('fill', '#cccccc')\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Create flow_levels density patterns for this watershed color\r\n",
+      "        patterns = patternGen.ballDensity(\r\n",
+      "            levels=flow_levels + 3,\r\n",
+      "            fills=[color],\r\n",
+      "            prefix=f\"watershed_{i}_flow\"\r\n",
+      "        )[:flow_levels]\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        if debug:\r\n",
+      "            print(f\"Watershed {i}: generated {len(patterns)} patterns with color {color}\")\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Store pattern indices\r\n",
+      "        start_idx = len(all_patterns)\r\n",
+      "        watershed_to_patterns[i] = list(range(start_idx, start_idx + flow_levels))\r\n",
+      "        all_patterns.extend(patterns)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Build overlay\r\n",
+      "    grid = terrain.hexGrid\r\n",
+      "    overlay = \"\"\r\n",
+      "    used_patterns = set()\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Map each hex to its watershed\r\n",
+      "    hex_to_watershed = {}\r\n",
+      "    for i, watershed in enumerate(self.sheds):\r\n",
+      "        for hex_idx in watershed.region.hexes:\r\n",
+      "            hex_to_watershed[hex_idx] = i\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Find max flow for normalization\r\n",
+      "    watershed_hexes = set(hex_to_watershed.keys())\r\n",
+      "    max_flow = max((flow_data[h] for h in watershed_hexes if flow_data[h] > 0), default=1.0)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    if debug:\r\n",
+      "        print(f\"Max flow in watersheds: {max_flow}\")\r\n",
+      "        print(f\"Min density: {min_density * 100}%\")\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Generate hex polygons\r\n",
+      "    for hex_idx in watershed_hexes:\r\n",
+      "        if hex_idx not in hex_to_watershed:\r\n",
+      "            continue\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        watershed_idx = hex_to_watershed[hex_idx]\r\n",
+      "        flow = flow_data[hex_idx]\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Normalize flow to [min_density, 1.0] range\r\n",
+      "        if flow > 0 and max_flow > 0:\r\n",
+      "            normalized_flow = (flow / max_flow)  # [0, 1]\r\n",
+      "            # Scale to [min_density, 1.0]\r\n",
+      "            scaled_flow = min_density + normalized_flow * (1.0 - min_density)\r\n",
+      "            flow_level = int(scaled_flow * (flow_levels - 1))\r\n",
+      "            flow_level = min(flow_level, flow_levels - 1)\r\n",
+      "        else:\r\n",
+      "            flow_level = 0  # Use minimum density pattern\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Get pattern index\r\n",
+      "        pattern_indices = watershed_to_patterns[watershed_idx]\r\n",
+      "        pattern_idx = pattern_indices[flow_level]\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        used_patterns.add(pattern_idx)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Generate polygon\r\n",
+      "        patName = all_patterns[pattern_idx].attributes['id']\r\n",
+      "        fill = f\"url(#{patName})\"\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        hex_obj = grid.hexes[hex_idx]\r\n",
+      "        ret = \"<polygon points=\\\"\"\r\n",
+      "        for point in hex_obj.vertices():\r\n",
+      "            ret += f\"{point.x:.0f},{point.y:.0f} \"\r\n",
+      "        ret += f\"\\\" style=\\\"fill:{fill}\\\"/>\"\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        overlay += \"\\t\" + ret + \"\\n\"\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Add used patterns to builder\r\n",
+      "    for pattern_idx in sorted(used_patterns):\r\n",
+      "        grid.builder.add_definition(all_patterns[pattern_idx])\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    if debug:\r\n",
+      "        print(f\"Used {len(used_patterns)} patterns out of {len(all_patterns)}\")\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    return overlay\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "# %% ../../nbs/water/basin.ipynb #2b3db31a\r\n",
+      "@patch\r\n",
+      "def draw_watersheds(self: DrainageBasins, top_n: int = 8, simplify_k: int = 3, max_width: float = None,lake_base_size: int = 3) -> str:\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "    watersheds = self.get_major(top_n)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    if max_width is None:\r\n",
+      "        max_width = self.terrain.hexGrid.radius * 2 / 3\r\n",
+      "    # Compute max flow across all selected rivers\r\n",
+      "    max_flow = 0\r\n",
+      "    for ws in watersheds:\r\n",
+      "        flows = ws.calculate_flow()\r\n",
+      "        if flows:\r\n",
+      "            max_flow = max(max_flow, max(flows.values()))\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Draw each watershed, passing max_flow for absolute scaling\r\n",
+      "    svg = \"\"\r\n",
+      "    for shed in watersheds:\r\n",
+      "        #svg += shed.simplify(simplify_k).draw(max_flow=max_flow)\r\n",
+      "        svg += shed.draw(max_flow=max_flow,\r\n",
+      "            max_width=max_width,\r\n",
+      "            lake_base_size=lake_base_size\r\n",
+      "        )\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    return svg\r\n",
+      "\r\n",

+      "# %% ../../nbs/water/erode.ipynb #e60e9c22\r\n",
+      "@dataclass\r\n",
+      "class ErosionModel:\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Simple erosion model with age parameter.\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    terrain: 'Terrain'\r\n",
+      "    soil_system: 'SoilSystem'\r\n",
+      "    age: float = 1.0  # 0.1 = young/new world, 1.0 = old world\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    def erode(self, iterations: int = 1, base_rate: float = 5.0, deposition_threshold: float = 50.0):\r\n",
+      "        \"\"\"Run erosion simulation.\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        Args:\r\n",
+      "            iterations: Number of erosion passes (age scales this)\r\n",
+      "            base_rate: Base erosion amount per unit stream power\r\n",
+      "            deposition_threshold: Elevation below which deposition occurs\r\n",
+      "        \"\"\"\r\n",
+      "        effective_iters = max(1, int(iterations * self.age))\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        for _ in range(effective_iters):\r\n",
+      "            self._erode_pass(base_rate, deposition_threshold)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    def _update_soils(self, eroded: np.ndarray, deposited: np.ndarray):\r\n",
+      "        \"\"\"Update soil types based on erosion/deposition.\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "        soil_types = self.terrain.fields['soil_type']\r\n",
+      "        elevations = self.terrain.elevations\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        for i in range(len(elevations)):\r\n",
+      "            if deposited[i] > 5:\r\n",
+      "                # Significant deposition → Alluvial\r\n",
+      "                soil_types[i] = 4\r\n",
+      "            elif eroded[i] < -20:\r\n",
+      "                # Heavy erosion → expose bedrock\r\n",
+      "                if elevations[i] > 500:\r\n",
+      "                    soil_types[i] = 0  # Granite\r\n",
+      "                else:\r\n",
+      "                    soil_types[i] = 1  # Basalt\r\n",
+      "            elif eroded[i] < -5:\r\n",
+      "                # Moderate erosion → sandstone/limestone\r\n",
+      "                soil_types[i] = 3 if soil_types[i] > 2 else 2\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Rebuild regions\r\n",
+      "        for type_idx in range(len(self.soil_system.types)):\r\n",
+      "            hexes = set(np.where(soil_types == type_idx)[0])\r\n",
+      "            self.soil_system.regions[type_idx] = HexRegion(hexes=hexes, hexGrid=self.terrain.hexGrid)\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "# %% ../../nbs/water/erode.ipynb #82eba692\r\n",
+      "@patch\r\n",
+      "def _find_knickpoints(self: ErosionModel, river: River, gradient_threshold: float = 15.0) -> list[int]:\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Find knickpoints (sudden gradient changes) in a river.\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Returns hex indices where gradient spikes (potential waterfalls).\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    gradient = river._calculate_gradient()\r\n",
+      "    knickpoints = []\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Walk upstream looking for gradient jumps\r\n",
+      "    for node in river.tree.all_nodes():\r\n",
+      "        for i, hex_idx in enumerate(node.data):\r\n",
+      "            if gradient.get(hex_idx, 0) > gradient_threshold:\r\n",
+      "                knickpoints.append(hex_idx)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    return knickpoints\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "@patch\r\n",
+      "def _migrate_knickpoint(self: ErosionModel, hex_idx: int, river: River, migration_rate: float = 0.5):\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Migrate a knickpoint upstream by eroding the lip.\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Args:\r\n",
+      "        hex_idx: Current knickpoint location\r\n",
+      "        river: The river containing this knickpoint\r\n",
+      "        migration_rate: How much to erode (scaled by age and soil)\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    terrain = self.terrain\r\n",
+      "    soil_types = terrain.fields.get('soil_type', np.zeros(len(terrain.elevations), dtype=int))\r\n",
+      "    types = self.soil_system.types\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Get soil resistance at knickpoint\r\n",
+      "    resistance = types[soil_types[hex_idx]].erosion_resistance\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Find upstream hex(es) - these form the \"lip\" of the waterfall\r\n",
+      "    upstream_hexes = []\r\n",
+      "    for node in river.tree.all_nodes():\r\n",
+      "        if hex_idx in node.data:\r\n",
+      "            idx = node.data.index(hex_idx)\r\n",
+      "            # Upstream is later in the list (remember: outlet is first)\r\n",
+      "            if idx < len(node.data) - 1:\r\n",
+      "                upstream_hexes.append(node.data[idx + 1])\r\n",
+      "            # Also check child nodes (tributaries joining here)\r\n",
+      "            for child in river.tree.children(node.identifier):\r\n",
+      "                upstream_hexes.append(child.data[0])\r\n",
+      "            break\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    if not upstream_hexes:\r\n",
+      "        return\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Calculate erosion at the lip\r\n",
+      "    current_elev = terrain.elevations[hex_idx]\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    for upstream_idx in upstream_hexes:\r\n",
+      "        upstream_elev = terrain.elevations[upstream_idx]\r\n",
+      "        drop = upstream_elev - current_elev\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        if drop > 5:  # Only erode if there's a real drop\r\n",
+      "            # Erosion inversely proportional to resistance\r\n",
+      "            erosion = migration_rate * self.age * drop / (resistance + 0.1)\r\n",
+      "            erosion = min(erosion, drop * 0.5)  # Don't over-erode\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            # Erode the upstream lip\r\n",
+      "            terrain.elevations[upstream_idx] -= erosion\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            # If we've eroded through soft rock to hard rock, slow down\r\n",
+      "            if erosion > 10 and soil_types[upstream_idx] in [3, 4]:  # Sandstone/Alluvial\r\n",
+      "                # Expose harder rock underneath\r\n",
+      "                soil_types[upstream_idx] = 2  # Limestone (harder)\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "@patch  \r\n",
+      "def _erode_pass(self: ErosionModel, base_rate: float, deposition_threshold: float):\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Single erosion pass with knickpoint migration.\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    terrain = self.terrain\r\n",
+      "    soil_types = terrain.fields.get('soil_type', np.zeros(len(terrain.elevations), dtype=int))\r\n",
+      "    types = self.soil_system.types\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Get rivers and compute power\r\n",
+      "    peaks = terrain.find_peaks(40, 1)\r\n",
+      "    rivers = [River.from_peak(terrain, p) for p in peaks]\r\n",
+      "    rivers = [r for r in rivers if r]\r\n",
+      "    rivers = River.combine_rivers(rivers)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    adjustments = np.zeros(len(terrain.elevations))\r\n",
+      "    deposited = np.zeros(len(terrain.elevations))\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    for river in rivers:\r\n",
+      "        flow = river._calculate_flow()\r\n",
+      "        gradient = river._calculate_gradient()\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # === KNICKPOINT MIGRATION ===\r\n",
+      "        knickpoints = self._find_knickpoints(river, gradient_threshold=12.0)\r\n",
+      "        for kp in knickpoints:\r\n",
+      "            self._migrate_knickpoint(kp, river, migration_rate=0.8)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # === FLUVIAL EROSION ===\r\n",
+      "        for hex_idx in river.hexes:\r\n",
+      "            power = flow[hex_idx] * gradient[hex_idx]\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            soil_idx = soil_types[hex_idx]\r\n",
+      "            resistance = types[soil_idx].erosion_resistance\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            erosion = base_rate * power * self.age / (resistance + 0.1)\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            elev = terrain.elevations[hex_idx]\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            if elev < deposition_threshold and gradient[hex_idx] < 5:\r\n",
+      "                deposited[hex_idx] += erosion * 0.3\r\n",
+      "            else:\r\n",
+      "                adjustments[hex_idx] -= erosion\r\n",
+      "                \r\n",
+      "                for neighbor in terrain.hexGrid.neighborsOf(hex_idx):\r\n",
+      "                    if neighbor >= 0 and terrain.elevations[neighbor] < elev:\r\n",
+      "                        adjustments[neighbor] -= erosion * 0.3 / (resistance + 0.1)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Apply changes\r\n",
+      "    terrain.elevations = np.clip(terrain.elevations + adjustments + deposited, 0, None)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    self._update_soils(adjustments, deposited)\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "# AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! File to edit: ../nbs/08_hydrology.ipynb.\r\n",
+      "\r\n",

+      "\r\n",
+      "# %% ../nbs/08_hydrology.ipynb #2a819c68\r\n",
+      "#find_river_sources() - source detection\r\n",
+      "@patch\r\n",
+      "def find_river_sources(self: Terrain, \r\n",
+      "                       min_precipitation=500,   # mm/year\r\n",
+      "                       min_elevation=500,       # meters\r\n",
+      "                       top_n=20,\r\n",
+      "                       debug = False):               # Return top N sources\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    Find potential river source locations based on precipitation and elevation.\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Good sources have:\r\n",
+      "    - High precipitation (rain/snowmelt)\r\n",
+      "    - High elevation (mountains to flow down from)\r\n",
+      "    - Not ocean\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Returns list of (hex_index, score) tuples sorted by score.\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    if 'precipitation' not in self.fields:\r\n",
+      "        raise ValueError(\"Must compute precipitation first (compute_precipitation_sb)\")\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    sources = []\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    for i in range(len(self.elevations)):\r\n",
+      "        elev = self.elevations[i]\r\n",
+      "        precip = self.fields['precipitation'][i]\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Skip ocean\r\n",
+      "        if elev <= 0:\r\n",
+      "            continue\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Check thresholds\r\n",
+      "        if precip >= min_precipitation and elev >= min_elevation:\r\n",
+      "            # Score = precipitation * elevation (higher = better source)\r\n",
+      "            score = precip * (elev / 1000.0)  # Normalize elevation\r\n",
+      "            sources.append((i, precip, elev, score))\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Sort by score descending\r\n",
+      "    sources.sort(key=lambda x: x[3], reverse=True)\r\n",
+      "    if debug:\r\n",
+      "        print(f\"\\n=== RIVER SOURCE ANALYSIS ===\")\r\n",
+      "        print(f\"Found {len(sources)} potential sources (precip >= {min_precipitation}mm, elev >= {min_elevation}m)\")\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "        if sources:\r\n",
+      "            print(f\"\\nTop {min(top_n, len(sources))} sources:\")\r\n",
+      "            print(f\"{'Rank':<6} {'Hex':<8} {'Precip':<12} {'Elev':<10} {'Score':<10}\")\r\n",
+      "            print(\"-\" * 50)\r\n",
+      "            for rank, (idx, precip, elev, score) in enumerate(sources[:top_n], 1):\r\n",
+      "                print(f\"{rank:<6} {idx:<8} {precip:<12.0f} {elev:<10.0f} {score:<10.1f}\")\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    return sources\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "# %% ../nbs/08_hydrology.ipynb #05aacfa6\r\n",
+      "# visualize_river_sources() - source visualization\r\n",
+      "@patch\r\n",
+      "def visualize_river_sources(self: Terrain,\r\n",
+      "                            min_precipitation=500,\r\n",
+      "                            min_elevation=500,\r\n",
+      "                            layer_name=\"river_sources\"):\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Visualize potential river source locations on the map.\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    sources = self.find_river_sources(min_precipitation, min_elevation)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    if not sources:\r\n",
+      "        print(\"No sources found with current thresholds\")\r\n",
+      "        return\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Create a field marking source strength\r\n",
+      "    source_field = np.zeros(len(self.elevations))\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Normalize scores for visualization\r\n",
+      "    max_score = sources[0][3] if sources else 1\r\n",
+      "    for idx, precip, elev, score in sources:\r\n",
+      "        source_field[idx] = score / max_score  # 0-1 normalized\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Create color gradient (blue = strong source)\r\n",
+      "    colors = [\"#ffffff\", \"#e3f2fd\", \"#90caf9\", \"#42a5f5\", \"#1e88e5\", \"#1565c0\"]\r\n",
+      "    thresholds = [0.01, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9]\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Bin sources\r\n",
+      "    source_indices = np.digitize(source_field, thresholds)\r\n",
+      "    source_indices = np.clip(source_indices, 0, len(colors) - 1)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Only show hexes that are actual sources\r\n",
+      "    source_set = {s[0] for s in sources}\r\n",
+      "    for i in range(len(source_indices)):\r\n",
+      "        if i not in source_set:\r\n",
+      "            source_indices[i] = 0  # White/transparent for non-sources\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Create patterns\r\n",
+      "    patternGen = TerrainPatterns(self)\r\n",
+      "    patterns = patternGen.ballDensity(len(colors), fills=colors, prefix=\"source\")\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Generate overlay\r\n",
+      "    overlay = self.makeOverlay(source_indices, patterns)\r\n",
+      "    self.builder.adjust(layer_name, overlay)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    return sources\r\n",
+      "\r\n",

+      "# %% ../nbs/08_hydrology.ipynb #4f544760\r\n",
+      "#create_valley_river() - river creation\r\n",
+      "@patch\r\n",
+      "def create_valley_river(self: Terrain, source_hex, valley_floor=20):\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Create river that flows through the valley.\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    path = [source_hex]\r\n",
+      "    current = source_hex\r\n",
+      "    accumulated_flow = self.fields['precipitation'][source_hex]\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    visited = {source_hex}\r\n",
+      "    max_length = 100  # Prevent infinite loops\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    while len(path) < max_length:\r\n",
+      "        lowest = self.lowest_neighbor(current)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Stop conditions\r\n",
+      "        if lowest is None:\r\n",
+      "            break\r\n",
+      "        if lowest in visited:  # Prevent loops\r\n",
+      "            break\r\n",
+      "        if self.elevations[lowest] < 1:  # Hit ocean\r\n",
+      "            path.append(lowest)\r\n",
+      "            break\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "        # Add rainfall contribution\r\n",
+      "        accumulated_flow += self.fields['precipitation'][lowest]\r\n",
+      "        path.append(lowest)\r\n",
+      "        visited.add(lowest)\r\n",
+      "        current = lowest\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Continue through valley (lower threshold)\r\n",
+      "        if self.elevations[current] < valley_floor:\r\n",
+      "            # In valley - keep going to find outlet\r\n",
+      "            continue\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    if len(path) < 3:\r\n",
+      "        return None\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "    river = River(self)\r\n",
+      "    path.reverse()\r\n",
+      "    river.tree.create_node(tag=\"segment\", identifier=0, data=path)\r\n",
+      "    river.hexes.update(path)\r\n",
+      "    river.accumulated_rainfall = accumulated_flow\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    return river\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "# %% ../nbs/08_hydrology.ipynb #2f2918c6\r\n",
+      "#calculate_flow_from_rivers() - flow calculation from rivers\r\n",
+      "@patch\r\n",
+      "def calculate_flow_from_rivers(self: Terrain, rivers: list):\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Populate flow and flow_direction fields from River objects.\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    n_hexes = len(self.elevations)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Initialize fields\r\n",
+      "    self.fields['flow'] = np.zeros(n_hexes)\r\n",
+      "    self.fields['flow_direction'] = np.array([None] * n_hexes, dtype=object)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    for river in rivers:\r\n",
+      "        # Calculate flow for this river\r\n",
+      "        river_flow = river._calculate_flow()\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Add to terrain fields\r\n",
+      "        for hex_idx, flow_count in river_flow.items():\r\n",
+      "            self.fields['flow'][hex_idx] += flow_count\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Set directions from river tree\r\n",
+      "        for node in river.tree.all_nodes():\r\n",
+      "            segment = node.data\r\n",
+      "            # Each hex flows to the previous one in the segment (toward outlet)\r\n",
+      "            for i in range(len(segment) - 1, 0, -1):\r\n",
+      "                current_hex = segment[i]\r\n",
+      "                next_hex = segment[i - 1]\r\n",
+      "                \r\n",
+      "                # Convert to HexPosition direction\r\n",
+      "                direction = self.hexGrid.index_to_hexposition(next_hex, current_hex)\r\n",
+      "                self.fields['flow_direction'][current_hex] = direction\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "# %% ../nbs/08_hydrology.ipynb #4ece6c00\r\n",
+      "#downsample_rivers_simple() - river downsampling\r\n",
+      "@patch\r\n",
+      "def downsample_rivers_simple(self: Terrain, sample_radius=2):\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Downsample river flow amounts only. Directions will be recalculated from elevation.\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    old_grid = self.hexGrid\r\n",
+      "    factor = sample_radius + 1\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    if 'flow' not in self.fields:\r\n",
+      "        return None\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    new_flow = []\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    for new_row in range(old_grid.nRows // factor):\r\n",
+      "        for new_col in range(old_grid.nCols // factor):\r\n",
+      "            # Find all old hexes in this region\r\n",
+      "            old_hexes = []\r\n",
+      "            for dr in range(factor):\r\n",
+      "                for dc in range(factor):\r\n",
+      "                    old_row = new_row * factor + dr\r\n",
+      "                    old_col = new_col * factor + dc\r\n",
+      "                    if old_row < old_grid.nRows and old_col < old_grid.nCols:\r\n",
+      "                        old_idx = old_grid.row_col_to_index(old_row, old_col)\r\n",
+      "                        if old_idx >= 0:\r\n",
+      "                            old_hexes.append(old_idx)\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            # Sum flow (accumulated rainfall/drainage)\r\n",
+      "            total_flow = sum(self.fields['flow'][h] for h in old_hexes)\r\n",
+      "            new_flow.append(total_flow)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    return np.array(new_flow)\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "# %% ../nbs/08_hydrology.ipynb #9c5603c7\r\n",
+      "#  trace_rivers_from_flow() - river tracing\r\n",
+      "@patch\r\n",
+      "def trace_rivers_from_flow(self: Terrain, min_flow=10, max_rivers=20):\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Create rivers by tracing downhill from high-flow hexes.\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    if 'flow' not in self.fields:\r\n",
+      "        raise ValueError(\"Must have flow field\")\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Find high-flow sources\r\n",
+      "    sources = []\r\n",
+      "    for i in range(len(self.fields['flow'])):\r\n",
+      "        if self.fields['flow'][i] >= min_flow and self.elevations[i] > 0:\r\n",
+      "            sources.append((i, self.fields['flow'][i]))\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    sources.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)\r\n",
+      "    sources = sources[:max_rivers]\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    rivers = []\r\n",
+      "    for source_idx, flow in sources:\r\n",
+      "        path = [source_idx]\r\n",
+      "        current = source_idx\r\n",
+      "        visited = {source_idx}\r\n",
+      "        ocean_outlet = None  # Track if we hit ocean\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Follow downhill gradient\r\n",
+      "        while len(path) < 100:  # Safety limit\r\n",
+      "            lowest = self.lowest_neighbor(current)\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            # Stop conditions\r\n",
+      "            if lowest is None:\r\n",
+      "                break\r\n",
+      "            if lowest in visited:\r\n",
+      "                break\r\n",
+      "            if self.elevations[lowest] <= 0:  # Hit ocean\r\n",
+      "                ocean_outlet = lowest  # Remember which ocean hex\r\n",
+      "                break\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            path.append(lowest)\r\n",
+      "            visited.add(lowest)\r\n",
+      "            current = lowest\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        if len(path) >= 3:\r\n",
+      "            river = River(self)\r\n",
+      "            path.reverse()  # Root at outlet\r\n",
+      "            river.tree.create_node(tag=\"segment\", identifier=0, data=path)\r\n",
+      "            river.hexes.update(path)\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "           \r\n",
+      "            river.ocean_outlet = ocean_outlet\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            rivers.append(river)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    return rivers\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "# %% ../nbs/08_hydrology.ipynb #1023e7b4\r\n",
+      "class Watershed:\r\n",
+      "   \r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "    def __init__(self, region: HexRegion, tributary: River, style: StyleCSS,system:SoilSystem=None):\r\n",
+      "        self.region = region\r\n",
+      "        self.tributary = tributary\r\n",
+      "        self.style = style\r\n",
+      "        self.terrain = tributary.terrain\r\n",
+      "        if system is None:\r\n",
+      "            system = SoilSystem.from_plates(self.terrain,[])\r\n",
+      "        self.system = system\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "    @property\r\n",
+      "    def terminal_hex(self) -> int:\r\n",
+      "        \"\"\"Find the hex with lowest elevation in this watershed.\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        Returns:\r\n",
+      "            Index of the lowest hex\r\n",
+      "        \"\"\"\r\n",
+      "        if not self.region.hexes:\r\n",
+      "            return None\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        terrain = self.tributary.terrain\r\n",
+      "        lowest_idx = None\r\n",
+      "        lowest_elev = float('inf')\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        for hex_idx in self.region.hexes:\r\n",
+      "            elev = terrain.elevations[hex_idx]\r\n",
+      "            if elev < lowest_elev:\r\n",
+      "                lowest_elev = elev\r\n",
+      "                lowest_idx = hex_idx\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        return lowest_idx\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "    @property\r\n",
+      "    def is_ocean(self) -> bool:\r\n",
+      "        \"\"\"Check if this watershed drains to the ocean.\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "        return self.tributary.ocean_outlet is not None\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "    @classmethod\r\n",
+      "    def river_peak(cls, terrain, peak_index):\r\n",
+      "        \"\"\"Create a Watershed by tracing downhill from a peak.\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Trace downhill\r\n",
+      "        path = [peak_index]\r\n",
+      "        current = peak_index\r\n",
+      "        ocean_outlet = None\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        while True:\r\n",
+      "            lowest = terrain.lowest_neighbor(current)\r\n",
+      "            if lowest is None:\r\n",
+      "                break\r\n",
+      "            if terrain.elevations[lowest] <= 0:\r\n",
+      "                ocean_outlet = lowest\r\n",
+      "                path.append(lowest)\r\n",
+      "                break\r\n",
+      "            path.append(lowest)\r\n",
+      "            current = lowest\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        if len(path) < 2:\r\n",
+      "            return None\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Build River\r\n",
+      "        path.reverse()\r\n",
+      "        river = River(terrain)\r\n",
+      "        river.tree.create_node(tag=\"segment\", identifier=0, data=path)\r\n",
+      "        river.hexes.update(path)\r\n",
+      "        river.ocean_outlet = ocean_outlet\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Wrap in Watershed\r\n",
+      "        region = HexRegion(hexes=river.hexes.copy(), hexGrid=terrain.hexGrid)\r\n",
+      "        style = StyleCSS(\"default\", fill=\"#cccccc\")  # Placeholder, assigned later\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        return cls(region=region, tributary=river, style=style)\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "    @classmethod\r\n",
+      "    def from_peak(cls, terrain, peak_index):\r\n",
+      "        \"\"\"Create a river by tracing downhill from a peak.\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Trace downhill to find the outlet first\r\n",
+      "        path = [peak_index]\r\n",
+      "        current = peak_index\r\n",
+      "        ocean_outlet = None  # Track which ocean hex we hit\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        while True:\r\n",
+      "            lowest = terrain.lowest_neighbor(current)\r\n",
+      "            # Stop if local minimum\r\n",
+      "            if lowest is None:\r\n",
+      "                break\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            # Check if we hit ocean\r\n",
+      "            if terrain.elevations[lowest] <= 0:\r\n",
+      "                ocean_outlet = lowest  # Remember the ocean hex\r\n",
+      "                path.append(lowest)    # ← ADD THIS LINE\r\n",
+      "                break\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            path.append(lowest)\r\n",
+      "            current = lowest\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Don't create river if path is too short\r\n",
+      "        if len(path) < 2:\r\n",
+      "            return None\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Build tree from outlet (root) upward\r\n",
+      "        path.reverse()\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        river = River(terrain)\r\n",
+      "        river.tree.create_node(tag=\"segment\", identifier=0, data=path)\r\n",
+      "        river.hexes.update(path)\r\n",
+      "        river.ocean_outlet = ocean_outlet  # Store which ocean hex we flow to\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        return river\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    @classmethod\r\n",
+      "    def compute_all(cls, terrain: Terrain, num_peaks: int = 50, min_height: int = 1, debug: bool = False) -> list['Watershed']:\r\n",
+      "        \"\"\"Compute all watersheds by:\r\n",
+      "        1. Find peaks and create rivers\r\n",
+      "        2. Merge rivers using River.combine_rivers()\r\n",
+      "        3. Assign each land hex to the river it flows into\r\n",
+      "        \"\"\"\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Step 1: Find peaks and create rivers\r\n",
+      "        sources = terrain.find_river_sources(\r\n",
+      "        min_precipitation=terrain.climate.precip_bins[0],  # Use first bin\r\n",
+      "        min_elevation=100,\r\n",
+      "        top_n=num_peaks\r\n",
+      "        )\r\n",
+      "        peaks = [idx for idx, precip, elev, score in sources]\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "        rivers = [River.from_peak(terrain, peak) for peak in peaks]\r\n",
+      "        rivers = [r for r in rivers if r is not None]\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        if debug:\r\n",
+      "            print(f\"\\n=== STEP 1: Created {len(rivers)} rivers from {len(peaks)} peaks ===\")\r\n",
+      "            for i, river in enumerate(rivers[:5]):  # Show first 5\r\n",
+      "                print(f\"  River {i}: {len(river.hexes)} hexes, outlet={river.ocean_outlet}\")\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Step 2: Merge intersecting rivers\r\n",
+      "        merged_rivers = River.combine_rivers(rivers)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        if debug:\r\n",
+      "            print(f\"\\n=== STEP 2: Merged to {len(merged_rivers)} rivers ===\")\r\n",
+      "            for i, river in enumerate(merged_rivers):\r\n",
+      "                outlet_type = \"ocean\" if river.ocean_outlet is not None else \"lake/none\"\r\n",
+      "                print(f\"  River {i}: {len(river.hexes)} hexes, outlet={outlet_type}\")\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Step 3: For each land hex, trace downhill to find which river it flows to\r\n",
+      "        hex_to_river = {}  # hex_idx -> river_index\r\n",
+      "        unassigned = []  # Track hexes that don't reach any river\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        for i in range(len(terrain.elevations)):\r\n",
+      "            if terrain.elevations[i] <= 0:\r\n",
+      "                continue  # Skip ocean\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            # Trace downhill until we hit a river or ocean\r\n",
+      "            current = i\r\n",
+      "            visited = {i}\r\n",
+      "            path_length = 0\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            while True:\r\n",
+      "                # Check if current hex is in any river\r\n",
+      "                for river_idx, river in enumerate(merged_rivers):\r\n",
+      "                    if current in river.hexes:\r\n",
+      "                        hex_to_river[i] = river_idx\r\n",
+      "                        break\r\n",
+      "                \r\n",
+      "                if i in hex_to_river:\r\n",
+      "                    break\r\n",
+      "                \r\n",
+      "                # Move downhill\r\n",
+      "                lowest = terrain.lowest_neighbor(current)\r\n",
+      "                if lowest is None or lowest in visited:\r\n",
+      "                    unassigned.append((i, \"local_minimum\", path_length))\r\n",
+      "                    break  # Local minimum (lake)\r\n",
+      "                if terrain.elevations[lowest] <= 0:\r\n",
+      "                    unassigned.append((i, \"ocean_direct\", path_length))\r\n",
+      "                    break  # Hit ocean without hitting river\r\n",
+      "                \r\n",
+      "                visited.add(lowest)\r\n",
+      "                current = lowest\r\n",
+      "                path_length += 1\r\n",
+      "                \r\n",
+      "                if path_length > 100:  # Safety\r\n",
+      "                    unassigned.append((i, \"too_long\", path_length))\r\n",
+      "                    break\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        if debug:\r\n",
+      "            print(f\"\\n=== STEP 3: Traced {len(hex_to_river)} land hexes to rivers ===\")\r\n",
+      "            print(f\"  Unassigned: {len(unassigned)} hexes\")\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            # Show breakdown of unassigned reasons\r\n",
+      "            from collections import Counter\r\n",
+      "            reasons = Counter(reason for _, reason, _ in unassigned)\r\n",
+      "            for reason, count in reasons.items():\r\n",
+      "                print(f\"    {reason}: {count}\")\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            # Show which rivers got the most drainage\r\n",
+      "            river_sizes = {}\r\n",
+      "            for hex_idx, river_idx in hex_to_river.items():\r\n",
+      "                river_sizes[river_idx] = river_sizes.get(river_idx, 0) + 1\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            print(f\"\\n  Top 5 watersheds by drainage area:\")\r\n",
+      "            for river_idx, count in sorted(river_sizes.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:5]:\r\n",
+      "                river_hexes = len(merged_rivers[river_idx].hexes)\r\n",
+      "                print(f\"    River {river_idx}: {count} drainage hexes + {river_hexes} river hexes = {count + river_hexes} total\")\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Step 4: Create watersheds from rivers + assigned hexes\r\n",
+      "        colors = StyleCSS.seaborn(\"tab20\", levels=20)\r\n",
+      "        watersheds = []\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        for river_idx, river in enumerate(merged_rivers):\r\n",
+      "            # Collect all hexes that flow to this river\r\n",
+      "            basin_hexes = set(river.hexes)\r\n",
+      "            for hex_idx, assigned_river in hex_to_river.items():\r\n",
+      "                if assigned_river == river_idx:\r\n",
+      "                    basin_hexes.add(hex_idx)\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            region = HexRegion(hexes=basin_hexes, hexGrid=terrain.hexGrid)\r\n",
+      "            style = colors[river_idx % len(colors)]\r\n",
+      "            river.terrain = terrain\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            watershed = cls(\r\n",
+      "                region=region,\r\n",
+      "                tributary=river,\r\n",
+      "                style=style\r\n",
+      "            )\r\n",
+      "            watersheds.append(watershed)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        if debug:\r\n",
+      "            print(f\"\\n=== STEP 4: Created {len(watersheds)} watersheds ===\")\r\n",
+      "            total_assigned = sum(len(w.region.hexes) for w in watersheds)\r\n",
+      "            total_land = sum(1 for e in terrain.elevations if e > 0)\r\n",
+      "            print(f\"  Total coverage: {total_assigned}/{total_land} land hexes ({100*total_assigned/total_land:.1f}%)\")\r\n",
+      "            for i, watershed in enumerate(watersheds):\r\n",
+      "                print(f\"  Watershed {i}: {len(watershed.region.hexes)} hexes, {watershed.tributary.terrain}\")\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        return watersheds\r\n",
+      "\r\n",

+      "@patch\r\n",
+      "def max_flow_hex(self:Watershed):\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Return (terminal_hex_id, total_water_volume) for the watershed.\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    flows = self.calculate_flow()\r\n",
+      "    calculate_flow\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    return (self.terminal_hex, flows[self.terminal_hex])\r\n",
