+      "# %% ../nbs/08_hydrology.ipynb #7d27869b\r\n",
+      "@patch\r\n",
+      "def lake_basin(self: Watershed, base_size: int = 3, log_scale: float = 2.0, max_hexes=None, debug=False) -> HexRegion:\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    Create a lake basin at the terminal hex, sized by log of accumulated flow.\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Args:\r\n",
+      "        base_size: Minimum lake size in hexes\r\n",
+      "        log_scale: Controls how much flow increases size (higher = bigger lakes)\r\n",
+      "        debug: Print step-by-step hex additions\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Returns:\r\n",
+      "        HexRegion representing the lake basin\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    flows = self.calculate_flow()\r\n",
+      "    terminal = self.terminal_hex\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    if terminal is None or terminal not in flows:\r\n",
+      "        if debug:\r\n",
+      "            print(f\"No valid terminal hex (terminal={terminal})\")\r\n",
+      "        return HexRegion(hexes=set(), hexGrid=self.terrain.hexGrid)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    if max_hexes is None:\r\n",
+      "        max_hexes = len(self.region.hexes)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "    # Log scale: size = base + log_scale * log10(flow)\r\n",
+      "    flow = max(1, flows[terminal])\r\n",
+      "    target_hexes = int(base_size + log_scale * math.log10(flow))\r\n",
+      "    target_hexes = max(1, target_hexes)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    if debug:\r\n",
+      "        print(f\"\\n=== LAKE BASIN GROWTH ===\")\r\n",
+      "        print(f\"Terminal hex: {terminal}, elevation: {self.terrain.elevations[terminal]:.1f}\")\r\n",
+      "        print(f\"Flow at terminal: {flow:.1f}\")\r\n",
+      "        print(f\"Target size: {target_hexes} hexes (base={base_size}, log_scale={log_scale})\")\r\n",
+      "        print(f\"Max hexes: {max_hexes}\")\r\n",
+      "        print(f\"\\nGrowth steps:\")\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Grow from terminal by adding lowest neighbors\r\n",
+      "    lake_hexes = {terminal}\r\n",
+      "    candidates = []\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    if debug:\r\n",
+      "        print(f\"  Step 0: Added terminal {terminal} (elev={self.terrain.elevations[terminal]:.1f})\")\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    for neighbor in self.terrain.hexGrid.neighborsOf(terminal):\r\n",
+      "        if neighbor >= 0 and neighbor in self.region.hexes:\r\n",
+      "            heapq.heappush(candidates, (self.terrain.elevations[neighbor], neighbor))\r\n",
+      "            if debug:\r\n",
+      "                print(f\"    Candidate: {neighbor} (elev={self.terrain.elevations[neighbor]:.1f})\")\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    step = 1\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    while len(lake_hexes) < target_hexes and len(lake_hexes) < max_hexes and candidates:\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "        elev, hex_idx = heapq.heappop(candidates)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        if hex_idx in lake_hexes:\r\n",
+      "            if debug:\r\n",
+      "                print(f\"  Step {step}: Skipped {hex_idx} (already in lake)\")\r\n",
+      "            continue\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        lake_hexes.add(hex_idx)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        if debug:\r\n",
+      "            print(f\"  Step {step}: Added {hex_idx} (elev={elev:.1f}), lake size={len(lake_hexes)}\")\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        new_candidates = 0\r\n",
+      "        for neighbor in self.terrain.hexGrid.neighborsOf(hex_idx):\r\n",
+      "            if neighbor >= 0 and neighbor not in lake_hexes and neighbor in self.region.hexes:\r\n",
+      "                heapq.heappush(candidates, (self.terrain.elevations[neighbor], neighbor))\r\n",
+      "                new_candidates += 1\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        if debug and new_candidates > 0:\r\n",
+      "            print(f\"    Added {new_candidates} new candidates\")\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        step += 1\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    if debug:\r\n",
+      "        print(f\"\\nFinal lake: {len(lake_hexes)} hexes\")\r\n",
+      "        if candidates:\r\n",
+      "            print(f\"Remaining candidates: {len(candidates)}\")\r\n",
+      "        else:\r\n",
+      "            print(\"No more candidates\")\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    return HexRegion(hexes=lake_hexes, hexGrid=self.terrain.hexGrid)\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "# %% ../nbs/08_hydrology.ipynb #9fc076d9\r\n",
+      "@patch\r\n",
+      "def simplify(self: Watershed, k: int = 3) -> 'Watershed':\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Simplify watershed to k longest paths.\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Strategy:\r\n",
+      "    1. Find all leaf-to-terminal paths in the river tree\r\n",
+      "    2. Sort by length, keep top k\r\n",
+      "    3. For each of the k paths, trace a river from its highest hex\r\n",
+      "    4. Merge all k rivers together\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Args:\r\n",
+      "        k: Number of major tributaries to keep\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "    Returns:\r\n",
+      "        New Watershed with simplified river network\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    terrain = self.tributary.terrain\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Step 1: Find all paths from leaves to root\r\n",
+      "    all_paths = []\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    for node in self.tributary.tree.all_nodes():\r\n",
+      "        # Only start from leaves\r\n",
+      "        if self.tributary.tree.children(node.identifier):\r\n",
+      "            continue\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Trace path from this leaf to root\r\n",
+      "        path = []\r\n",
+      "        current = node\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        while current is not None:\r\n",
+      "            path.extend(current.data)\r\n",
+      "            parent_id = current.predecessor(self.tributary.tree.identifier)\r\n",
+      "            current = self.tributary.tree.get_node(parent_id) if parent_id else None\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        all_paths.append(path)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Step 2: Sort by length and keep top k\r\n",
+      "    all_paths.sort(key=len, reverse=True)\r\n",
+      "    top_paths = all_paths[:k]\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Step 3: Build k rivers from each path's highest hex\r\n",
+      "    rivers = []\r\n",
+      "    for path in top_paths:\r\n",
+      "        highest_hex = max(path, key=lambda h: terrain.elevations[h])\r\n",
+      "        new_river = Watershed.from_peak(terrain, highest_hex)\r\n",
+      "        if new_river is not None:\r\n",
+      "            rivers.append(new_river)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Step 4: Merge all rivers\r\n",
+      "    if not rivers:\r\n",
+      "        return self  # Fallback\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    merged_rivers = River.combine_rivers(rivers)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    if not merged_rivers:\r\n",
+      "        return self\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Take the largest merged river\r\n",
+      "    main_river = max(merged_rivers, key=lambda r: len(r.hexes))\r\n",
+      "    main_river.terrain = terrain\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Create new region with all hexes from simplified rivers\r\n",
+      "    new_region = HexRegion(\r\n",
+      "        hexes=main_river.hexes.copy(),\r\n",
+      "        hexGrid=terrain.hexGrid\r\n",
+      "    )\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    return Watershed(\r\n",
+      "        region=new_region,\r\n",
+      "        tributary=main_river,\r\n",
+      "        style=self.style\r\n",
+      "    )\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "# %% ../nbs/08_hydrology.ipynb #d1f8a9ae\r\n",
+      "@patch\r\n",
+      "def segments(self: Watershed) -> list[list[int]]:\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Extract hex segments from river tree, sorted high→low elevation.\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Each segment includes connection to parent (if any) at the start.\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Returns:\r\n",
+      "        List of hex index lists, each representing a connected branch/segment\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    terrain = self.tributary.terrain\r\n",
+      "    result = []\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    for node in self.tributary.tree.all_nodes():\r\n",
+      "        # Get land hexes only\r\n",
+      "        land_hexes = [h for h in node.data if terrain.elevations[h] > 0]\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Add ocean terminal if this is root and drains to ocean\r\n",
+      "        if node.identifier == self.tributary.tree.root and self.is_ocean:\r\n",
+      "            if self.terminal_hex is not None:\r\n",
+      "                land_hexes.append(self.terminal_hex)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        if len(land_hexes) >= 2:\r\n",
+      "            # If this node has a parent, prepend the connection point\r\n",
+      "            parent_id = node.predecessor(self.tributary.tree.identifier)\r\n",
+      "            if parent_id is not None:\r\n",
+      "                parent_node = self.tributary.tree.get_node(parent_id)\r\n",
+      "                # Last hex of parent is the connection point\r\n",
+      "                connection_hex = parent_node.data[-1]\r\n",
+      "                land_hexes.insert(0, connection_hex)\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            # Sort by elevation: highest first\r\n",
+      "            land_hexes.sort(key=lambda h: terrain.elevations[h], reverse=True)\r\n",
+      "            result.append(land_hexes)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    return result\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "# %% ../nbs/08_hydrology.ipynb #f0146c87\r\n",
+      "@patch\r\n",
+      "def segment_to_points(self: Watershed, hexes: list[int]) -> list[MapCord]:\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Convert hex indices to drawable points, handling ocean termination.\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    If last hex is at/below sea level, use midpoint between it and \r\n",
+      "    the last land hex instead of ocean hex center.\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Args:\r\n",
+      "        hexes: List of hex indices (high→low elevation)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "    Returns:\r\n",
+      "        List of MapCord points for drawing\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    terrain = self.tributary.terrain\r\n",
+      "    grid = terrain.hexGrid\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    if not hexes:\r\n",
+      "        return []\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    points = []\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Find first underwater hex (if any)\r\n",
+      "    ocean_idx = None\r\n",
+      "    for i, h in enumerate(hexes):\r\n",
+      "        if terrain.elevations[h] <= 0:\r\n",
+      "            ocean_idx = i\r\n",
+      "            break\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    if ocean_idx is None:\r\n",
+      "        # No ocean - just use all hex centers\r\n",
+      "        for h in hexes:\r\n",
+      "            points.append(grid.hexes[h].center)\r\n",
+      "    else:\r\n",
+      "        # Add land hex centers up to (but not including) ocean\r\n",
+      "        for h in hexes[:ocean_idx]:\r\n",
+      "            points.append(grid.hexes[h].center)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Add midpoint between last land hex and ocean hex\r\n",
+      "        if ocean_idx > 0:\r\n",
+      "            last_land = grid.hexes[hexes[ocean_idx - 1]].center\r\n",
+      "            ocean_hex = grid.hexes[hexes[ocean_idx]].center\r\n",
+      "            midpoint = MapCord(\r\n",
+      "                (last_land.x + ocean_hex.x) / 2,\r\n",
+      "                (last_land.y + ocean_hex.y) / 2\r\n",
+      "            )\r\n",
+      "            points.append(midpoint)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    return points\r\n",
+      "\r\n",

+      "def watershed_overlay(self:DrainageBasins):\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Demo showing watersheds colored by drainage basin.\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "    # Create overlay for watershed colors\r\n",

+      "        self.terrain.hexGrid.builder.add_style(watershed.style)\r\n",

+      "        for hex_idx in watershed.region.hexes:\r\n",
+      "            hex_obj = self.terrain.hexGrid.hexes[hex_idx]\r\n",

+      "                hex_obj.style.name, \r\n",
+      "                watershed.style.name\r\n",
+      "            )\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Add watershed overlay as new layer\r\n",
+      "    return overlay\r\n",

+      "@patch\r\n",
+      "def boundary_overlay(self:DrainageBasins,\r\n",
+      "                boundary_style = StyleCSS(\"watershed_boundary\", \r\n",
+      "                             fill=\"none\", \r\n",
+      "                             stroke=\"#000000\", \r\n",
+      "                             stroke_width=2,\r\n",
+      "                             opacity=0.8)):\r\n",
+      "    # Optionally draw watershed boundaries\r\n",
+      "    overlay = \"\"\r\n",
+      "    self.terrain.hexGrid.builder.add_style(boundary_style)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    for watershed in self.sheds:\r\n",
+      "        paths = watershed.region.trace_perimeter(style=boundary_style)\r\n",
+      "        for path in paths:\r\n",
+      "            overlay += path.svg()\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    return overlay\r\n",
+      "\r\n",

+      "# %% ../nbs/08_hydrology.ipynb #5941a02c\r\n",
+      "@patch\r\n",
+      "def select_shed(self: DrainageBasins, \r\n",
+      "                                    min_flow: int = 10,\r\n",
+      "                                    max_rivers: int = 20,\r\n",
+      "                                    min_length: int = 5) -> List[Watershed]:\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Select the most important rivers to display.\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Strategy:\r\n",
+      "    1. One main river per major watershed (largest basins)\r\n",
+      "    2. Rivers must have significant flow (min_flow)\r\n",
+      "    3. Rivers must be long enough to be visible (min_length)\r\n",
+      "    4. Prioritize by watershed size and flow\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Args:\r\n",
+      "        min_flow: Minimum accumulated flow to show\r\n",
+      "        max_rivers: Maximum number of rivers to return\r\n",
+      "        min_length: Minimum number of hexes in river path\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Returns:\r\n",
+      "        List of River objects suitable for display\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    candidates = []\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    for watershed in self.sheds:\r\n",
+      "        river = watershed.tributary\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Calculate river metrics\r\n",
+      "        flow_values = river._calculate_flow()\r\n",
+      "        max_flow = max(flow_values.values()) if flow_values else 0\r\n",
+      "        river_length = len(river.hexes)\r\n",
+      "        watershed_size = len(watershed.region.hexes)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Score = combination of flow, length, and watershed size\r\n",
+      "        score = max_flow * 0.5 + river_length * 0.3 + watershed_size * 0.2\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Filter by minimum criteria\r\n",
+      "        if max_flow >= min_flow and river_length >= min_length:\r\n",
+      "            candidates.append((watershed, score, max_flow, river_length))\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Sort by score descending\r\n",
+      "    candidates.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Return top N watershed\r\n",
+      "    return [watershed for watershed, _, _, _ in candidates[:max_rivers]]\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "# %% ../nbs/08_hydrology.ipynb #2c9d1041\r\n",
+      "@patch\r\n",
+      "def gradient_overlay(self: DrainageBasins,\r\n",
+      "                     min_width: float = 0.5,\r\n",
+      "                     max_width: float = 4.0,\r\n",
+      "                     opacity: float = 0.6):\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Create overlay showing flow direction with gradient-based line widths.\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Each line segment:\r\n",
+      "    - Connects a land hex to its downhill neighbor\r\n",
+      "    - Colored by watershed\r\n",
+      "    - Width scaled by elevation gradient (steeper = thicker)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Args:\r\n",
+      "        min_width: Minimum line width (for flat areas)\r\n",
+      "        max_width: Maximum line width (for steep slopes)\r\n",
+      "        opacity: Line opacity (0-1)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Returns:\r\n",
+      "        SVG string of line segments\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    terrain = self.terrain\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # First pass: calculate all gradients to find max for normalization\r\n",
+      "    gradients = []\r\n",
+      "    flow_data = []  # Store (hex_idx, neighbor_idx, gradient, watershed_idx)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Map each hex to its watershed\r\n",
+      "    hex_to_watershed = {}\r\n",
+      "    for i, watershed in enumerate(self.sheds):\r\n",
+      "        for hex_idx in watershed.region.hexes:\r\n",
+      "            hex_to_watershed[hex_idx] = i\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    for hex_idx in hex_to_watershed.keys():\r\n",
+      "        # Find lowest neighbor (flow direction)\r\n",
+      "        lowest = terrain.lowest_neighbor(hex_idx)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        if lowest is None or terrain.elevations[lowest] <= 0:\r\n",
+      "            continue  # Skip if no downhill or flows to ocean\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Calculate gradient\r\n",
+      "        elev_current = terrain.elevations[hex_idx]\r\n",
+      "        elev_next = terrain.elevations[lowest]\r\n",
+      "        elev_drop = elev_current - elev_next\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Distance between hex centers\r\n",
+      "        hex_obj = terrain.hexGrid.hexes[hex_idx]\r\n",
+      "        neighbor_obj = terrain.hexGrid.hexes[lowest]\r\n",
+      "        distance = hex_obj.center.distance(neighbor_obj.center)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        gradient = elev_drop / distance if distance > 0 else 0\r\n",
+      "        gradients.append(gradient)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        watershed_idx = hex_to_watershed[hex_idx]\r\n",
+      "        flow_data.append((hex_idx, lowest, gradient, watershed_idx))\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Find max gradient for normalization\r\n",
+      "    max_gradient = max(gradients) if gradients else 1.0\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Second pass: generate SVG lines\r\n",
+      "    overlay = \"\"\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Create styles for each watershed with opacity\r\n",
+      "    for i, watershed in enumerate(self.sheds):\r\n",
+      "        # Create a modified style with opacity for lines\r\n",
+      "        line_style = StyleCSS(\r\n",
+      "            f\"{watershed.style.name}_flow\",\r\n",
+      "            stroke=watershed.style.properties.get('fill', '#000000'),\r\n",
+      "            fill=\"none\",\r\n",
+      "            opacity=opacity,\r\n",
+      "            stroke_linecap=\"round\"\r\n",
+      "        )\r\n",
+      "        terrain.hexGrid.builder.add_style(line_style)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Generate line segments\r\n",
+      "    for hex_idx, neighbor_idx, gradient, watershed_idx in flow_data:\r\n",
+      "        # Normalize gradient and calculate width\r\n",
+      "        normalized = gradient / max_gradient if max_gradient > 0 else 0\r\n",
+      "        width = min_width + normalized * (max_width - min_width)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Get hex centers\r\n",
+      "        hex_obj = terrain.hexGrid.hexes[hex_idx]\r\n",
+      "        neighbor_obj = terrain.hexGrid.hexes[neighbor_idx]\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Get watershed style\r\n",
+      "        watershed = self.sheds[watershed_idx]\r\n",
+      "        style_name = f\"{watershed.style.name}_flow\"\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Create line segment\r\n",
+      "        overlay += (\r\n",
+      "            f'\\t<line '\r\n",
+      "            f'x1=\"{hex_obj.center.x:.1f}\" '\r\n",
+      "            f'y1=\"{hex_obj.center.y:.1f}\" '\r\n",
+      "            f'x2=\"{neighbor_obj.center.x:.1f}\" '\r\n",
+      "            f'y2=\"{neighbor_obj.center.y:.1f}\" '\r\n",
+      "            f'class=\"{style_name}\" '\r\n",
+      "            f'stroke-width=\"{width:.2f}\" '\r\n",
+      "            f'/>\\n'\r\n",
+      "        )\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    return overlay\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "\r\n",

+      "# %% ../nbs/08_hydrology.ipynb #dd7c3ac7\r\n",
+      "@patch\r\n",
+      "def dotted_watershed_overlay(self: DrainageBasins, \r\n",
+      "                              flow_levels: int = 5,\r\n",
+      "                              min_density: float = 0.25,  # NEW: minimum dot density\r\n",
+      "                              debug: bool = False) -> str:\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Create dotted watershed overlay where dot density represents flow accumulation.\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Args:\r\n",
+      "        flow_levels: Number of dot density levels (default 5)\r\n",
+      "        min_density: Minimum density for low-flow areas (0.25 = 25%)\r\n",
+      "        debug: Print pattern generation info\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Returns:\r\n",
+      "        SVG string for the overlay\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    terrain = self.terrain\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Ensure we have flow data\r\n",
+      "    if 'flow' not in terrain.fields:\r\n",
+      "        all_flows = {}\r\n",
+      "        for watershed in self.sheds:\r\n",
+      "            river_flow = watershed.tributary._calculate_flow()\r\n",
+      "            for hex_idx, flow_count in river_flow.items():\r\n",
+      "                all_flows[hex_idx] = all_flows.get(hex_idx, 0) + flow_count\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        terrain.fields['flow'] = np.zeros(len(terrain.elevations))\r\n",
+      "        for hex_idx, flow in all_flows.items():\r\n",
+      "            terrain.fields['flow'][hex_idx] = flow\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    flow_data = terrain.fields['flow']\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Generate patterns for each watershed\r\n",
+      "    patternGen = TerrainPatterns(terrain)\r\n",
+      "    all_patterns = []\r\n",
+      "    watershed_to_patterns = {}\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    for i, watershed in enumerate(self.sheds):\r\n",
+      "        color = watershed.style.properties.get('fill', '#cccccc')\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Create flow_levels density patterns for this watershed color\r\n",
+      "        patterns = patternGen.ballDensity(\r\n",
+      "            levels=flow_levels + 3,\r\n",
+      "            fills=[color],\r\n",
+      "            prefix=f\"watershed_{i}_flow\"\r\n",
+      "        )[:flow_levels]\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        if debug:\r\n",
+      "            print(f\"Watershed {i}: generated {len(patterns)} patterns with color {color}\")\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Store pattern indices\r\n",
+      "        start_idx = len(all_patterns)\r\n",
+      "        watershed_to_patterns[i] = list(range(start_idx, start_idx + flow_levels))\r\n",
+      "        all_patterns.extend(patterns)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Build overlay\r\n",
+      "    grid = terrain.hexGrid\r\n",
+      "    overlay = \"\"\r\n",
+      "    used_patterns = set()\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Map each hex to its watershed\r\n",
+      "    hex_to_watershed = {}\r\n",
+      "    for i, watershed in enumerate(self.sheds):\r\n",
+      "        for hex_idx in watershed.region.hexes:\r\n",
+      "            hex_to_watershed[hex_idx] = i\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Find max flow for normalization\r\n",
+      "    watershed_hexes = set(hex_to_watershed.keys())\r\n",
+      "    max_flow = max((flow_data[h] for h in watershed_hexes if flow_data[h] > 0), default=1.0)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    if debug:\r\n",
+      "        print(f\"Max flow in watersheds: {max_flow}\")\r\n",
+      "        print(f\"Min density: {min_density * 100}%\")\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Generate hex polygons\r\n",
+      "    for hex_idx in watershed_hexes:\r\n",
+      "        if hex_idx not in hex_to_watershed:\r\n",
+      "            continue\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        watershed_idx = hex_to_watershed[hex_idx]\r\n",
+      "        flow = flow_data[hex_idx]\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Normalize flow to [min_density, 1.0] range\r\n",
+      "        if flow > 0 and max_flow > 0:\r\n",
+      "            normalized_flow = (flow / max_flow)  # [0, 1]\r\n",
+      "            # Scale to [min_density, 1.0]\r\n",
+      "            scaled_flow = min_density + normalized_flow * (1.0 - min_density)\r\n",
+      "            flow_level = int(scaled_flow * (flow_levels - 1))\r\n",
+      "            flow_level = min(flow_level, flow_levels - 1)\r\n",
+      "        else:\r\n",
+      "            flow_level = 0  # Use minimum density pattern\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Get pattern index\r\n",
+      "        pattern_indices = watershed_to_patterns[watershed_idx]\r\n",
+      "        pattern_idx = pattern_indices[flow_level]\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        used_patterns.add(pattern_idx)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Generate polygon\r\n",
+      "        patName = all_patterns[pattern_idx].attributes['id']\r\n",
+      "        fill = f\"url(#{patName})\"\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        hex_obj = grid.hexes[hex_idx]\r\n",
+      "        ret = \"<polygon points=\\\"\"\r\n",
+      "        for point in hex_obj.vertices():\r\n",
+      "            ret += f\"{point.x:.0f},{point.y:.0f} \"\r\n",
+      "        ret += f\"\\\" style=\\\"fill:{fill}\\\"/>\"\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        overlay += \"\\t\" + ret + \"\\n\"\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Add used patterns to builder\r\n",
+      "    for pattern_idx in sorted(used_patterns):\r\n",
+      "        grid.builder.add_definition(all_patterns[pattern_idx])\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    if debug:\r\n",
+      "        print(f\"Used {len(used_patterns)} patterns out of {len(all_patterns)}\")\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    return overlay\r\n",
+      "\r\n",

+      "class RiverDemo:\r\n",
+      "    def __init__(self):\r\n",

+      "\r\n",
+      "# %% ../../nbs/water/river.ipynb #77f6b2d1\r\n",
+      "class River:\r\n",
+      "    def __init__(self, terrain):\r\n",
+      "        self.terrain = terrain\r\n",
+      "        self.tree = Tree()\r\n",
+      "        self.hexes = set()  # All hex indices for quick intersection checks\r\n",
+      "        self.ocean_outlet = None\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "    @property\r\n",
+      "    def is_empty(self):\r\n",
+      "        return self.tree.size() == 0\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    @classmethod\r\n",
+      "    def from_peak(cls, terrain, peak_index):\r\n",
+      "        \"\"\"Create a river by tracing downhill from a peak.\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "        path = [peak_index]\r\n",
+      "        current = peak_index\r\n",
+      "        ocean_outlet = None\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "        while True:\r\n",
+      "            lowest = terrain.lowest_neighbor(current)\r\n",
+      "            if lowest is None:\r\n",
+      "                break\r\n",
+      "            if terrain.elevations[lowest] <= 0:\r\n",
+      "                ocean_outlet = lowest  # ← Save the ocean hex\r\n",
+      "                path.append(lowest)  # ← Add this\r\n",
+      "                break\r\n",
+      "            path.append(lowest)\r\n",
+      "            current = lowest\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "        if len(path) < 2:\r\n",
+      "            return None\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "        path.reverse()\r\n",
+      "        river = cls(terrain)\r\n",
+      "        river.tree.create_node(tag=\"segment\", identifier=0, data=path)\r\n",
+      "        river.hexes.update(path)\r\n",
+      "        river.ocean_outlet = ocean_outlet  # ← Set it on the river\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        return river\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    @staticmethod\r\n",
+      "    def combine_rivers(rivers):\r\n",
+      "        \"\"\"Merge intersecting rivers, return list with no intersections.\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "        result = list(rivers)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        changed = True\r\n",
+      "        while changed:\r\n",
+      "            changed = False\r\n",
+      "            for i in range(len(result)):\r\n",
+      "                for j in range(i + 1, len(result)):\r\n",
+      "                    # Check for intersection\r\n",
+      "                    intersection = result[i].hexes & result[j].hexes\r\n",
+      "                    if intersection:\r\n",
+      "                        # Merge j into i\r\n",
+      "                        merged = result[i]._merge_with(result[j], intersection)\r\n",
+      "                        result[i] = merged\r\n",
+      "                        result.pop(j)\r\n",
+      "                        changed = True\r\n",
+      "                        break\r\n",
+      "                if changed:\r\n",
+      "                    break\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        result = [r for r in result if not r.is_empty]\r\n",
+      "        return result\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    def _merge_with(self, other, intersection):\r\n",
+      "        \"\"\"Merge another river into this one at intersection point.\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "        # TODO: implement tree merging logic\r\n",
+      "        # For now, just combine the hex sets\r\n",
+      "        merged = River(self.terrain)\r\n",
+      "        merged.hexes = self.hexes | other.hexes\r\n",
+      "        # Tree merging is more complex - need to attach other's\r\n",
+      "        # upstream portion at the intersection point\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "        merged.ocean_outlet = self.ocean_outlet or other.ocean_outlet\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "        return merged\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "   \r\n",
+      "    @staticmethod\r\n",
+      "    def decode(s: str, terrain):\r\n",
+      "        \"\"\"Decode river from string format.\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "        river = River(terrain)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        if s.strip() == \"empty\":\r\n",
+      "            return river\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        lines = s.strip().split('\\n')\r\n",
+      "        in_tree = False\r\n",
+      "        nodes_data = {}  # id -> (parent_id, hex_list)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        for line in lines:\r\n",
+      "            if line.startswith('outlet:'):\r\n",
+      "                river.ocean_outlet = int(line.split(':')[1])\r\n",
+      "            elif line.startswith('+tree:'):\r\n",
+      "                in_tree = True\r\n",
+      "            elif line.startswith('-tree:'):\r\n",
+      "                in_tree = False\r\n",
+      "            elif in_tree:\r\n",
+      "                parts = line.split('|')\r\n",
+      "                node_id = int(parts[0])\r\n",
+      "                parent_id = int(parts[1]) if parts[1] else None\r\n",
+      "                hex_list = [int(h) for h in parts[2].split(',')]\r\n",
+      "                nodes_data[node_id] = (parent_id, hex_list)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Build tree - process nodes ensuring parents exist first\r\n",
+      "        added = set()\r\n",
+      "        while len(added) < len(nodes_data):\r\n",
+      "            for node_id, (parent_id, hex_list) in nodes_data.items():\r\n",
+      "                if node_id in added:\r\n",
+      "                    continue\r\n",
+      "                # Can add if root or parent already added\r\n",
+      "                if parent_id is None or parent_id in added:\r\n",
+      "                    river.tree.create_node(tag=\"segment\", identifier=node_id,\r\n",
+      "                                        parent=parent_id, data=hex_list)\r\n",
+      "                    river.hexes.update(hex_list)\r\n",
+      "                    added.add(node_id)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        return river\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "# %% ../../nbs/water/river.ipynb #cad6d55c\r\n",
+      "@patch\r\n",
+      "def encode(self: River):\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Encode river to string format.\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    if self.is_empty:\r\n",
+      "        return \"empty\"\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    lines = []\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    if self.ocean_outlet is not None:\r\n",
+      "        lines.append(f\"outlet:{self.ocean_outlet}\")\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    lines.append(\"+tree:\")\r\n",
+      "    # BFS order ensures parents are encoded before children\r\n",
+      "    for node_id in self.tree.expand_tree(mode=Tree.WIDTH):\r\n",
+      "        node = self.tree[node_id]\r\n",
+      "        parent_id = \"\" if node.predecessor(self.tree.identifier) is None else node.predecessor(self.tree.identifier)\r\n",
+      "        hex_str = ','.join(str(h) for h in node.data)\r\n",
+      "        lines.append(f\"{node.identifier}|{parent_id}|{hex_str}\")\r\n",
+      "    lines.append(\"-tree:\")\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    return '\\n'.join(lines)\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "\r\n",

+      "# %% ../../nbs/water/river.ipynb #785479e1\r\n",
+      "@patch \r\n",
+      "def _merge_with(self:River, other, intersection):\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Merge another river into this one at intersection point.\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    merged = River(self.terrain)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Start with a copy of self's tree\r\n",
+      "    merged.tree = Tree(self.tree, deep=True)\r\n",
+      "    merged.hexes = self.hexes.copy()\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Find the furthest upstream intersection point (highest elevation)\r\n",
+      "    intersection_hex = max(intersection, key=lambda h: self.terrain.elevations[h])\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    for node in merged.tree.all_nodes():\r\n",
+      "        if intersection_hex in node.data:\r\n",
+      "            # Found the node containing intersection\r\n",
+      "            idx = node.data.index(intersection_hex)\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            if idx == len(node.data) - 1:\r\n",
+      "                # Case 1: intersection at end of list\r\n",
+      "                attach_point = node.identifier\r\n",
+      "            else:\r\n",
+      "                # Case 2: intersection in middle - need to split\r\n",
+      "                # Keep [0:idx+1] in current node\r\n",
+      "                downstream = node.data[:idx+1]\r\n",
+      "                upstream = node.data[idx+1:]\r\n",
+      "                \r\n",
+      "                node.data = downstream\r\n",
+      "                \r\n",
+      "                # Create new child with upstream portion\r\n",
+      "                new_id = merged.tree.size()\r\n",
+      "                merged.tree.create_node(\r\n",
+      "                    tag=\"segment\",\r\n",
+      "                    identifier=new_id,\r\n",
+      "                    parent=node.identifier,\r\n",
+      "                    data=upstream\r\n",
+      "                )\r\n",
+      "                \r\n",
+      "                # Move existing children to new node\r\n",
+      "                for child in merged.tree.children(node.identifier):\r\n",
+      "                    if child.identifier != new_id:\r\n",
+      "                        merged.tree.move_node(child.identifier, new_id)\r\n",
+      "                \r\n",
+      "                attach_point = node.identifier\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            # Now trim and attach other tree\r\n",
+      "            trimmed_other = merged._trim_tree(other, intersection_hex)\r\n",
+      "            if trimmed_other:\r\n",
+      "                merged._attach_tree(trimmed_other, attach_point)\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            break\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    merged.hexes.update(other.hexes)\r\n",
+      "    return merged\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "@patch \r\n",
+      "def _trim_tree(self:River, other, intersection_hex):\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Return a copy of other's tree with everything at/below intersection removed.\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    # Find node containing intersection in other's tree\r\n",
+      "    for node in other.tree.all_nodes():\r\n",
+      "        if intersection_hex in node.data:\r\n",
+      "            idx = node.data.index(intersection_hex)\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            # Keep only portion after intersection\r\n",
+      "            if idx == len(node.data) - 1:\r\n",
+      "                # Intersection at end, keep children\r\n",
+      "                # Return subtree starting from children\r\n",
+      "                trimmed = Tree()\r\n",
+      "                for child in other.tree.children(node.identifier):\r\n",
+      "                    trimmed = other.tree.subtree(child.identifier)\r\n",
+      "                    break  # For now just take first child, may need to handle multiple\r\n",
+      "                return trimmed\r\n",
+      "            else:\r\n",
+      "                # Split node, keep upstream portion\r\n",
+      "                trimmed = Tree(other.tree, deep=True)\r\n",
+      "                trim_node = trimmed.get_node(node.identifier)\r\n",
+      "                trim_node.data = trim_node.data[idx+1:]\r\n",
+      "                return trimmed\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    return None\r\n",
+      "@patch \r\n",
+      "def _attach_tree(self:River, other_tree, parent_id):\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Attach other_tree's root(s) as children of parent_id.\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    if other_tree.size() == 0:\r\n",
+      "        return\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Get next available ID\r\n",
+      "    next_id = self.tree.size()\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Recursively copy nodes from other_tree\r\n",
+      "    def copy_subtree(other_node, new_parent_id):\r\n",
+      "        nonlocal next_id\r\n",
+      "        new_node_id = next_id\r\n",
+      "        next_id += 1\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        self.tree.create_node(\r\n",
+      "            tag=other_node.tag,\r\n",
+      "            identifier=new_node_id,\r\n",
+      "            parent=new_parent_id,\r\n",
+      "            data=other_node.data.copy()\r\n",
+      "        )\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        for child in other_tree.children(other_node.identifier):\r\n",
+      "            copy_subtree(child, new_node_id)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Copy from other's root\r\n",
+      "    other_root = other_tree.get_node(other_tree.root)\r\n",
+      "    copy_subtree(other_root, parent_id)\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "\r\n",

+      "# %% ../../nbs/water/river.ipynb #b890c33b\r\n",
+      "@patch\r\n",
+      "def svg(self: River, styles=[StyleCSS(\"river\", fill=\"none\", stroke=\"blue\", stroke_width=4)]) -> str:\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Render river as SVG path.\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Args:\r\n",
+      "        styles: List of styles for different depth levels (thicker for main channels)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Returns:\r\n",
+      "        SVG path string\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    ret = \"\"\r\n",
+      "    terrain = self.terrain\r\n",
+      "   \r\n",
+      "    for i, node in enumerate(self.tree.all_nodes()):\r\n",
+      "        points = []\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # If this node has a parent, add connection point\r\n",
+      "        parent_id = node.predecessor(self.tree.identifier)\r\n",
+      "        if parent_id is not None:\r\n",
+      "            parent_node = self.tree.get_node(parent_id)\r\n",
+      "            # Connect last point of child to first point of parent\r\n",
+      "            parent_first_hex = parent_node.data[-1]\r\n",
+      "            points.append(terrain.hexGrid.hexes[parent_first_hex].center)\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "        # Add all hex centers in this segment\r\n",
+      "        points.extend([terrain.hexGrid.hexes[idx].center for idx in node.data])\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # If this segment has ocean_outlet, extend to the border\r\n",
+      "        if self.ocean_outlet is not None:\r\n",
+      "            # Check if this is the outlet segment (last in path)\r\n",
+      "            if len(node.data) > 0:\r\n",
+      "                last_hex_idx = node.data[-1]\r\n",
+      "                last_hex = terrain.hexGrid.hexes[last_hex_idx]\r\n",
+      "                ocean_hex = terrain.hexGrid.hexes[self.ocean_outlet]\r\n",
+      "                \r\n",
+      "                # Add edge point (midpoint between last land hex and ocean hex)\r\n",
+      "                edge_point = MapCord(\r\n",
+      "                    (last_hex.center.x + ocean_hex.center.x) / 2,\r\n",
+      "                    (last_hex.center.y + ocean_hex.center.y) / 2\r\n",
+      "                )\r\n",
+      "                points.append(edge_point)\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "        # Select style based on tree depth (deeper = thicker)\r\n",
+      "        depth = self.tree.depth(node.identifier)\r\n",
+      "        style_index = min(depth, len(styles) - 1)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Create path and make it windy\r\n",
+      "        aPath = MapPath([], style=styles[style_index])\r\n",
+      "        aPath.points = points\r\n",
+      "        windy_river = aPath.make_windy(iterations=max(5 - i, 2), offset_factor=0.2)\r\n",
+      "        ret += windy_river.drawSpline()\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "    return ret\r\n",
+      "\r\n",

+      "@patch\r\n",
+      "def getLargestRiver(self:Terrain, num_peaks=40, min_height=1):\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Find peaks, create rivers, merge them, and return the largest one.\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    peaks = self.find_peaks(num_peaks, min_height)\r\n",
+      "    rivers = [River.from_peak(self, peak) for peak in peaks]\r\n",
+      "    rivers = [r for r in rivers if r is not None]\r\n",
+      "    merged = River.combine_rivers(rivers)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    if not merged:\r\n",
+      "        return None\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Return river with most hexes\r\n",
+      "    return max(merged, key=lambda r: len(r.hexes))\r\n",

+      "# %% ../../nbs/water/river.ipynb #73288bb5\r\n",
+      "@patch\r\n",
+      "def _calculate_flow(self:River):\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Calculate accumulated flow for each hex in the river.\r\n",
+      "    Returns dict mapping hex_index -> flow_count\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    flow = {}\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    def traverse(node):\r\n",
+      "        # Start with hexes in this segment\r\n",
+      "        segment_flow = {}\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Get flow from all children first (depth-first)\r\n",
+      "        child_flows = []\r\n",
+      "        for child in self.tree.children(node.identifier):\r\n",
+      "            child_flows.append(traverse(child))\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Process this segment from end to beginning (upstream to downstream)\r\n",
+      "        for i in range(len(node.data) - 1, -1, -1):\r\n",
+      "            hex_idx = node.data[i]\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            if i == len(node.data) - 1:\r\n",
+      "                # Last hex in segment - accumulate from children\r\n",
+      "                accumulated = 1  # This hex itself\r\n",
+      "                for child_flow in child_flows:\r\n",
+      "                    # Get flow from first hex of each child\r\n",
+      "                    accumulated += child_flow.get(node.data[i], 0)\r\n",
+      "            else:\r\n",
+      "                # Middle of segment - accumulate from next hex\r\n",
+      "                accumulated = 1 + segment_flow[node.data[i + 1]]\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            segment_flow[hex_idx] = accumulated\r\n",
+      "            flow[hex_idx] = accumulated\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        return segment_flow\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    root = self.tree.get_node(self.tree.root)\r\n",
+      "    traverse(root)\r\n",
+      "    return flow\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "# %% ../../nbs/water/river.ipynb #cbbcd791\r\n",
+      "@patch\r\n",
+      "def _calculate_gradient(self:River):\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Calculate elevation gradient for each hex in the river.\r\n",
+      "    Returns dict mapping hex_index -> elevation_drop\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    gradient = {}\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    def traverse(node):\r\n",
+      "        # Process each hex in this segment\r\n",
+      "        for i in range(len(node.data)):\r\n",
+      "            hex_idx = node.data[i]\r\n",
+      "            current_elev = self.terrain.elevations[hex_idx]\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            # Find next downstream hex\r\n",
+      "            if i > 0:\r\n",
+      "                # Next hex is earlier in the list (toward outlet)\r\n",
+      "                next_hex = node.data[i - 1]\r\n",
+      "            else:\r\n",
+      "                # At start of segment - check parent\r\n",
+      "                parent_id = node.predecessor(self.tree.identifier)\r\n",
+      "                if parent_id is not None:\r\n",
+      "                    parent_node = self.tree.get_node(parent_id)\r\n",
+      "                    next_hex = parent_node.data[-1]  # Last hex of parent\r\n",
+      "                else:\r\n",
+      "                    # At outlet - no gradient\r\n",
+      "                    gradient[hex_idx] = 0\r\n",
+      "                    continue\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            next_elev = self.terrain.elevations[next_hex]\r\n",
+      "            drop = max(0, current_elev - next_elev)  # Only positive drops\r\n",
+      "            gradient[hex_idx] = drop\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Recurse to children\r\n",
+      "        for child in self.tree.children(node.identifier):\r\n",
+      "            traverse(child)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    root = self.tree.get_node(self.tree.root)\r\n",
+      "    traverse(root)\r\n",
+      "    return gradient\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "# %% ../../nbs/water/river.ipynb #06d3828d\r\n",
+      "#find_river_sources() - source detection\r\n",
+      "@patch\r\n",
+      "def find_river_sources(self: Terrain, \r\n",
+      "                       min_precipitation=500,   # mm/year\r\n",
+      "                       min_elevation=500,       # meters\r\n",
+      "                       top_n=20,\r\n",
+      "                       debug = False):               # Return top N sources\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    Find potential river source locations based on precipitation and elevation.\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Good sources have:\r\n",
+      "    - High precipitation (rain/snowmelt)\r\n",
+      "    - High elevation (mountains to flow down from)\r\n",
+      "    - Not ocean\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Returns list of (hex_index, score) tuples sorted by score.\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    if 'precipitation' not in self.fields:\r\n",
+      "        raise ValueError(\"Must compute precipitation first (compute_precipitation_sb)\")\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    sources = []\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    for i in range(len(self.elevations)):\r\n",
+      "        elev = self.elevations[i]\r\n",
+      "        precip = self.fields['precipitation'][i]\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Skip ocean\r\n",
+      "        if elev <= 0:\r\n",
+      "            continue\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Check thresholds\r\n",
+      "        if precip >= min_precipitation and elev >= min_elevation:\r\n",
+      "            # Score = precipitation * elevation (higher = better source)\r\n",
+      "            score = precip * (elev / 1000.0)  # Normalize elevation\r\n",
+      "            sources.append((i, precip, elev, score))\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # Sort by score descending\r\n",
+      "    sources.sort(key=lambda x: x[3], reverse=True)\r\n",
+      "    if debug:\r\n",
+      "        print(f\"\\n=== RIVER SOURCE ANALYSIS ===\")\r\n",
+      "        print(f\"Found {len(sources)} potential sources (precip >= {min_precipitation}mm, elev >= {min_elevation}m)\")\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "        if sources:\r\n",
+      "            print(f\"\\nTop {min(top_n, len(sources))} sources:\")\r\n",
+      "            print(f\"{'Rank':<6} {'Hex':<8} {'Precip':<12} {'Elev':<10} {'Score':<10}\")\r\n",
+      "            print(\"-\" * 50)\r\n",
+      "            for rank, (idx, precip, elev, score) in enumerate(sources[:top_n], 1):\r\n",
+      "                print(f\"{rank:<6} {idx:<8} {precip:<12.0f} {elev:<10.0f} {score:<10.1f}\")\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    return sources\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "# %% ../../nbs/water/river.ipynb #9b090465\r\n",
+      "@patch\r\n",
+      "def carve(self:River, base_erosion=0.5, valley_width=3, lower = 40, shape='river'):\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Carve a valley along this river/glacier path.\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    adjustments = {}\r\n",
+      "    adjusted_hexes = set()\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # 1. Sort by elevation (highest first = upstream to downstream)\r\n",
+      "    sorted_hexes = sorted(self.hexes, key=lambda i: self.terrain.elevations[i], reverse=True)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    cumulative_flow = 0\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "    for hex_idx in sorted_hexes:\r\n",
+      "        self.terrain.elevations[hex_idx] = max(self.terrain.elevations[hex_idx]-lower,0)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    for i, hex_idx in enumerate(sorted_hexes):\r\n",
+      "        # 2. Calculate on the fly\r\n",
+      "        cumulative_flow += 1  # Each hex adds unit flow\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        if i < len(sorted_hexes) - 1:\r\n",
+      "            next_hex = sorted_hexes[i + 1]\r\n",
+      "            gradient = self.terrain.elevations[hex_idx] - self.terrain.elevations[next_hex] \r\n",
+      "        else:\r\n",
+      "            gradient = 0.1  # Small default at mouth\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        power = cumulative_flow * max(gradient, 0.01)\r\n",
+      "        erosion_amount = base_erosion * power\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Erode river hex itself\r\n",
+      "        if hex_idx not in adjusted_hexes:\r\n",
+      "            adjustments[hex_idx] = -erosion_amount\r\n",
+      "            adjusted_hexes.add(hex_idx)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # 3. Spread to neighbors (only unadjusted hexes)\r\n",
+      "        for dist in range(1, valley_width + 1):\r\n",
+      "            ring = self.terrain.ring(hex_idx, dist)\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            for n in ring:\r\n",
+      "                if n in adjusted_hexes:\r\n",
+      "                    continue\r\n",
+      "                \r\n",
+      "                if shape == 'river':\r\n",
+      "                    decay = erosion_amount * (0.5 ** dist)\r\n",
+      "                else:  # glacier\r\n",
+      "                    decay = erosion_amount * (1 - dist / (valley_width + 1))\r\n",
+      "                \r\n",
+      "                adjustments[n] = -decay\r\n",
+      "                adjusted_hexes.add(n)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    return adjustments\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "\r\n",

+      "def find_local_minima(self: Terrain) -> list[int]:\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Return indices of land hexes that are local minima (potential lakes).\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    directions = self.flow_directions()\r\n",
+      "    return [i for i in range(len(self.elevations)) \r\n",
+      "            if directions[i] == -1 and self.elevations[i] > 0]\r\n",
+      "\r\n",

+      "# %% ../../nbs/water/river.ipynb #b0f68267\r\n",
+      "#this is the more recent one\r\n",
+      "@patch\r\n",
+      "def find_drainage_path(self: Terrain, start: int) -> list[int]:\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Find lowest-cost path from start to ocean using Dijkstra.\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    Cost = elevation we'd need to carve (downhill = 0, uphill = diff).\r\n",
+      "    If no ocean exists, uses lowest boundary hex as outlet.\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    ocean = {i for i in range(len(self.elevations)) if self.elevations[i] <= 0}\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    if not ocean:\r\n",
+      "        # Find boundary hexes (those with < 6 valid neighbors)\r\n",
+      "        boundary = [i for i in range(len(self.elevations)) \r\n",
+      "                    if len([n for n in self.hexGrid.neighborsOf(i) if n >= 0]) < 6]\r\n",
+      "        # Use lowest boundary point as outlet\r\n",
+      "        ocean = {min(boundary, key=lambda i: self.elevations[i])}\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    if start in ocean:\r\n",
+      "        return [start]\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    # (cost, current_hex, path)\r\n",
+      "    pq = [(0, start, [start])]\r\n",
+      "    visited = set()\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    while pq:\r\n",
+      "        cost, current, path = heapq.heappop(pq)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        if current in visited:\r\n",
+      "            continue\r\n",
+      "        visited.add(current)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        if current in ocean:\r\n",
+      "            return path\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        for neighbor in self.hexGrid.neighborsOf(current):\r\n",
+      "            if neighbor < 0 or neighbor in visited:\r\n",
+      "                continue\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            # Cost = how much we'd need to lower neighbor to flow from current\r\n",
+      "            elev_curr = self.elevations[current]\r\n",
+      "            elev_neighbor = self.elevations[neighbor]\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            # To flow, neighbor must be < current\r\n",
+      "            carve_cost = max(0, elev_neighbor - elev_curr + 1)\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            new_cost = cost + carve_cost\r\n",
+      "            heapq.heappush(pq, (new_cost, neighbor, path + [neighbor]))\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    return []  # No path found\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "# %% ../../nbs/water/river.ipynb #6eeb3b81\r\n",
+      "@patch\r\n",
+      "def carve_to_ocean(self: Terrain, num_lakes: int = 5, max_iters: int = 10) -> list[River]:\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Carve drainage using lowest-cost paths to ocean (or boundary if no ocean).\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    paths = []\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    for iteration in range(max_iters):\r\n",
+      "        minima = find_local_minima(self)\r\n",
+      "        if len(minima) <= num_lakes:\r\n",
+      "            print(f\"Done at iter {iteration}: {len(minima)} lakes\")\r\n",
+      "            break\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Keep highest elevation minima as lakes\r\n",
+      "        minima.sort(key=lambda i: self.elevations[i], reverse=True)\r\n",
+      "        drain_these = minima[num_lakes:]\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        for lake_idx in drain_these:\r\n",
+      "            path = self.find_drainage_path(lake_idx)\r\n",
+      "            river = River(terrain=self)\r\n",
+      "                   \r\n",
+      "            # Create root node with the path as a single segment\r\n",
+      "            river.tree.create_node(tag=\"segment\", identifier=0, data=path)\r\n",
+      "            path.reverse()\r\n",
+      "            river.hexes.update(path)\r\n",
+      "            paths.append(river)\r\n",
+      "           \r\n",
+      "            if len(path) < 2:\r\n",
+      "                continue\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            # Carve monotonically decreasing along path\r\n",
+      "            for i in range(len(path) - 1):\r\n",
+      "                curr, next_hex = path[i], path[i + 1]\r\n",
+      "                \r\n",
+      "                if self.elevations[next_hex] >= self.elevations[curr]:\r\n",
+      "                    self.elevations[next_hex] = self.elevations[curr] - 1\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    return paths\r\n",
+      "\r\n",

+      "# %% ../../nbs/water/soil.ipynb #d108f30a\r\n",
+      "@patch\r\n",
+      "def flow_directions(self: Terrain) -> np.ndarray:\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Return array where each hex points to its downhill neighbor, or -1 if minimum.\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    n = len(self.elevations)\r\n",
+      "    directions = np.full(n, -1, dtype=int)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    for i in range(n):\r\n",
+      "        lowest = self.lowest_neighbor(i)\r\n",
+      "        if lowest is not None and self.elevations[lowest] < self.elevations[i]:\r\n",
+      "            directions[i] = lowest\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    return directions\r\n",

+      "# %% ../../nbs/water/soil.ipynb #a7ae2e7f\r\n",
+      "@dataclass\r\n",
+      "class SoilSystem:\r\n",
+      "    \"\"\"Manages soil types and their distribution across terrain.\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "    terrain: 'Terrain'\r\n",
+      "    types: List[SoilType]\r\n",
+      "    regions: List[HexRegion]  # One per type (index matches types)\r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    def __post_init__(self):\r\n",
+      "        \"\"\"Ensure terrain has soil_type field.\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "        if 'soil_type' not in self.terrain.fields:\r\n",
+      "            self.terrain.fields['soil_type'] = np.zeros(len(self.terrain.elevations), dtype=int)\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "    @classmethod\r\n",
+      "    def from_plates(cls, terrain: 'Terrain', plates: List['Plate'], \r\n",
+      "                    elev_threshold: float = 50.0,\r\n",
+      "                    precip_threshold: float = 750.0,\r\n",
+      "                    debug: bool = False) -> 'SoilSystem':\r\n",
+      "        \"\"\"Create soil system from plate tectonics and terrain properties.\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        Args:\r\n",
+      "            terrain: Terrain with elevations and climate data\r\n",
+      "            plates: List of tectonic plates\r\n",
+      "            elev_threshold: Elevation below which alluvial can form (meters)\r\n",
+      "            precip_threshold: Precipitation above which limestone forms (mm/year)\r\n",
+      "            debug: Print diagnostic info\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        Returns:\r\n",
+      "            SoilSystem with initial soil distribution\r\n",
+      "        \"\"\"\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        types = SoilType.standard_types()\r\n",
+      "        n_hexes = len(terrain.elevations)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Initialize soil_type array\r\n",
+      "        soil_type = np.zeros(n_hexes, dtype=int)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Map plates to hexes\r\n",
+      "        plate_map = {}  # hex_idx -> plate\r\n",
+      "        for plate in plates:\r\n",
+      "            for hex_idx in plate.hexes:\r\n",
+      "                plate_map[hex_idx] = plate\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Ensure we have distance_to_coast\r\n",
+      "        if 'distance_to_coast' not in terrain.fields:\r\n",
+      "            terrain.compute_distance_from_coast()\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Track counts for debug\r\n",
+      "        counts = {i: 0 for i in range(len(types))}\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        for i in range(n_hexes):\r\n",
+      "            elev = terrain.elevations[i]\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            # Ocean hexes get basalt (oceanic crust)\r\n",
+      "            if elev <= 0:\r\n",
+      "                soil_type[i] = 1  # Basalt\r\n",
+      "                counts[1] += 1\r\n",
+      "                continue\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            # Get plate type\r\n",
+      "            plate = plate_map.get(i)\r\n",
+      "            is_oceanic = plate and plate.kind == PlateKind.oceanic\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            # Coastal lowlands → Alluvial\r\n",
+      "            if elev < elev_threshold and terrain.fields['distance_to_coast'][i] <= 1:\r\n",
+      "                soil_type[i] = 4  # Alluvial\r\n",
+      "                counts[4] += 1\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            # High elevation → Bedrock (Granite or Basalt from plate)\r\n",
+      "            elif elev > 1000:\r\n",
+      "                if is_oceanic:\r\n",
+      "                    soil_type[i] = 1  # Basalt\r\n",
+      "                    counts[1] += 1\r\n",
+      "                else:\r\n",
+      "                    soil_type[i] = 0  # Granite\r\n",
+      "                    counts[0] += 1\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            # Mid elevation → Sedimentary (Limestone or Sandstone)\r\n",
+      "            else:\r\n",
+      "                # Use precipitation if available\r\n",
+      "                if 'precipitation' in terrain.fields:\r\n",
+      "                    precip = terrain.fields['precipitation'][i]\r\n",
+      "                    if precip > precip_threshold:\r\n",
+      "                        soil_type[i] = 2  # Limestone (wet)\r\n",
+      "                        counts[2] += 1\r\n",
+      "                    else:\r\n",
+      "                        soil_type[i] = 3  # Sandstone (dry)\r\n",
+      "                        counts[3] += 1\r\n",
+      "                else:\r\n",
+      "                    # Fallback: use plate type\r\n",
+      "                    if is_oceanic:\r\n",
+      "                        soil_type[i] = 2  # Limestone\r\n",
+      "                        counts[2] += 1\r\n",
+      "                    else:\r\n",
+      "                        soil_type[i] = 3  # Sandstone\r\n",
+      "                        counts[3] += 1\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Store in terrain\r\n",
+      "        terrain.fields['soil_type'] = soil_type\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Create regions for each type\r\n",
+      "        regions = []\r\n",
+      "        for type_idx in range(len(types)):\r\n",
+      "            hexes = set(np.where(soil_type == type_idx)[0])\r\n",
+      "            regions.append(HexRegion(hexes=hexes, hexGrid=terrain.hexGrid))\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        if debug:\r\n",
+      "            print(\"\\n=== SOIL SYSTEM CREATED ===\")\r\n",
+      "            print(f\"Total hexes: {n_hexes}\")\r\n",
+      "            for i, soil_type_obj in enumerate(types):\r\n",
+      "                pct = 100 * counts[i] / n_hexes\r\n",
+      "                print(f\"{soil_type_obj.name:12s}: {counts[i]:5d} hexes ({pct:5.1f}%)\")\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        return cls(terrain=terrain, types=types, regions=regions)\r\n",
+      "\r\n",

+      "class Watershed:\r\n",
+      "   \r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "    def __init__(self, region: HexRegion, tributary: River, style: StyleCSS,system:SoilSystem=None):\r\n",
+      "        self.region = region\r\n",
+      "        self.tributary = tributary\r\n",

+      "\r\n",
+      "    @property\r\n",
+      "    def terminal_hex(self) -> int:\r\n",
+      "        \"\"\"Find the hex with lowest elevation in this watershed.\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        Returns:\r\n",
+      "            Index of the lowest hex\r\n",
+      "        \"\"\"\r\n",
+      "        if not self.region.hexes:\r\n",
+      "            return None\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        terrain = self.tributary.terrain\r\n",
+      "        lowest_idx = None\r\n",
+      "        lowest_elev = float('inf')\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        for hex_idx in self.region.hexes:\r\n",
+      "            elev = terrain.elevations[hex_idx]\r\n",
+      "            if elev < lowest_elev:\r\n",
+      "                lowest_elev = elev\r\n",
+      "                lowest_idx = hex_idx\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        return lowest_idx\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "    @property\r\n",
+      "    def is_ocean(self) -> bool:\r\n",
+      "        \"\"\"Check if this watershed drains to the ocean.\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "        # Check explicit outlet first\r\n",
+      "        if self.tributary.ocean_outlet is not None:\r\n",
+      "            return True\r\n",
+      "        # Fallback: check if any river hex is in ocean\r\n",
+      "        for h in self.tributary.hexes:\r\n",
+      "            if self.terrain.elevations[h] <= 0:\r\n",
+      "                return True\r\n",
+      "        return False\r\n",
+      "\r\n",

+      "    @classmethod\r\n",
+      "    def river_peak(cls, terrain, peak_index):\r\n",
+      "        \"\"\"Create a Watershed by tracing downhill from a peak.\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Trace downhill\r\n",
+      "        path = [peak_index]\r\n",
+      "        current = peak_index\r\n",
+      "        ocean_outlet = None\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        while True:\r\n",
+      "            lowest = terrain.lowest_neighbor(current)\r\n",
+      "            if lowest is None:\r\n",
+      "                break\r\n",
+      "            if terrain.elevations[lowest] <= 0:\r\n",
+      "                ocean_outlet = lowest\r\n",
+      "                path.append(lowest)\r\n",
+      "                break\r\n",
+      "            path.append(lowest)\r\n",
+      "            current = lowest\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        if len(path) < 2:\r\n",
+      "            return None\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Build River\r\n",
+      "        path.reverse()\r\n",
+      "        river = River(terrain)\r\n",
+      "        river.tree.create_node(tag=\"segment\", identifier=0, data=path)\r\n",
+      "        river.hexes.update(path)\r\n",
+      "        river.ocean_outlet = ocean_outlet\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Wrap in Watershed\r\n",
+      "        region = HexRegion(hexes=river.hexes.copy(), hexGrid=terrain.hexGrid)\r\n",
+      "        style = StyleCSS(\"default\", fill=\"#cccccc\")  # Placeholder, assigned later\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        return cls(region=region, tributary=river, style=style)\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "    @classmethod\r\n",
+      "    def from_peak(cls, terrain, peak_index):\r\n",
+      "        \"\"\"Create a river by tracing downhill from a peak.\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Trace downhill to find the outlet first\r\n",
+      "        path = [peak_index]\r\n",
+      "        current = peak_index\r\n",
+      "        ocean_outlet = None  # Track which ocean hex we hit\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        while True:\r\n",
+      "            lowest = terrain.lowest_neighbor(current)\r\n",
+      "            # Stop if local minimum\r\n",
+      "            if lowest is None:\r\n",
+      "                break\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            # Check if we hit ocean\r\n",
+      "            if terrain.elevations[lowest] <= 0:\r\n",
+      "                ocean_outlet = lowest  # Remember the ocean hex\r\n",
+      "                path.append(lowest)    # ← ADD THIS LINE\r\n",
+      "                break\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            path.append(lowest)\r\n",
+      "            current = lowest\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Don't create river if path is too short\r\n",
+      "        if len(path) < 2:\r\n",
+      "            return None\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Build tree from outlet (root) upward\r\n",
+      "        path.reverse()\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        river = River(terrain)\r\n",
+      "        river.tree.create_node(tag=\"segment\", identifier=0, data=path)\r\n",
+      "        river.hexes.update(path)\r\n",
+      "        river.ocean_outlet = ocean_outlet  # Store which ocean hex we flow to\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        return river\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "    \r\n",
+      "    @classmethod\r\n",
+      "    def compute_all(cls, terrain: Terrain, num_peaks: int = 50, min_height: int = 1, debug: bool = False) -> list['Watershed']:\r\n",
+      "        \"\"\"Compute all watersheds by:\r\n",
+      "        1. Find peaks and create rivers\r\n",
+      "        2. Merge rivers using River.combine_rivers()\r\n",
+      "        3. Assign each land hex to the river it flows into\r\n",
+      "        \"\"\"\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Step 1: Find peaks and create rivers\r\n",
+      "        sources = terrain.find_river_sources(\r\n",
+      "        min_precipitation=terrain.climate.precip_bins[0],  # Use first bin\r\n",
+      "        min_elevation=100,\r\n",
+      "        top_n=num_peaks\r\n",
+      "        )\r\n",
+      "        peaks = [idx for idx, precip, elev, score in sources]\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "        rivers = [River.from_peak(terrain, peak) for peak in peaks]\r\n",
+      "        rivers = [r for r in rivers if r is not None]\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        if debug:\r\n",
+      "            print(f\"\\n=== STEP 1: Created {len(rivers)} rivers from {len(peaks)} peaks ===\")\r\n",
+      "            for i, river in enumerate(rivers[:5]):  # Show first 5\r\n",
+      "                print(f\"  River {i}: {len(river.hexes)} hexes, outlet={river.ocean_outlet}\")\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Step 2: Merge intersecting rivers\r\n",
+      "        merged_rivers = River.combine_rivers(rivers)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        if debug:\r\n",
+      "            print(f\"\\n=== STEP 2: Merged to {len(merged_rivers)} rivers ===\")\r\n",
+      "            for i, river in enumerate(merged_rivers):\r\n",
+      "                outlet_type = \"ocean\" if river.ocean_outlet is not None else \"lake/none\"\r\n",
+      "                print(f\"  River {i}: {len(river.hexes)} hexes, outlet={outlet_type}\")\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Step 3: For each land hex, trace downhill to find which river it flows to\r\n",
+      "        hex_to_river = {}  # hex_idx -> river_index\r\n",
+      "        unassigned = []  # Track hexes that don't reach any river\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        for i in range(len(terrain.elevations)):\r\n",
+      "            if terrain.elevations[i] <= 0:\r\n",
+      "                continue  # Skip ocean\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            # Trace downhill until we hit a river or ocean\r\n",
+      "            current = i\r\n",
+      "            visited = {i}\r\n",
+      "            path_length = 0\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            while True:\r\n",
+      "                # Check if current hex is in any river\r\n",
+      "                for river_idx, river in enumerate(merged_rivers):\r\n",
+      "                    if current in river.hexes:\r\n",
+      "                        hex_to_river[i] = river_idx\r\n",
+      "                        break\r\n",
+      "                \r\n",
+      "                if i in hex_to_river:\r\n",
+      "                    break\r\n",
+      "                \r\n",
+      "                # Move downhill\r\n",
+      "                lowest = terrain.lowest_neighbor(current)\r\n",
+      "                if lowest is None or lowest in visited:\r\n",
+      "                    unassigned.append((i, \"local_minimum\", path_length))\r\n",
+      "                    break  # Local minimum (lake)\r\n",
+      "                if terrain.elevations[lowest] <= 0:\r\n",
+      "                    unassigned.append((i, \"ocean_direct\", path_length))\r\n",
+      "                    break  # Hit ocean without hitting river\r\n",
+      "                \r\n",
+      "                visited.add(lowest)\r\n",
+      "                current = lowest\r\n",
+      "                path_length += 1\r\n",
+      "                \r\n",
+      "                if path_length > 100:  # Safety\r\n",
+      "                    unassigned.append((i, \"too_long\", path_length))\r\n",
+      "                    break\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        if debug:\r\n",
+      "            print(f\"\\n=== STEP 3: Traced {len(hex_to_river)} land hexes to rivers ===\")\r\n",
+      "            print(f\"  Unassigned: {len(unassigned)} hexes\")\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            # Show breakdown of unassigned reasons\r\n",
+      "            from collections import Counter\r\n",
+      "            reasons = Counter(reason for _, reason, _ in unassigned)\r\n",
+      "            for reason, count in reasons.items():\r\n",
+      "                print(f\"    {reason}: {count}\")\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            # Show which rivers got the most drainage\r\n",
+      "            river_sizes = {}\r\n",
+      "            for hex_idx, river_idx in hex_to_river.items():\r\n",
+      "                river_sizes[river_idx] = river_sizes.get(river_idx, 0) + 1\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            print(f\"\\n  Top 5 watersheds by drainage area:\")\r\n",
+      "            for river_idx, count in sorted(river_sizes.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:5]:\r\n",
+      "                river_hexes = len(merged_rivers[river_idx].hexes)\r\n",
+      "                print(f\"    River {river_idx}: {count} drainage hexes + {river_hexes} river hexes = {count + river_hexes} total\")\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Step 4: Create watersheds from rivers + assigned hexes\r\n",
+      "        colors = StyleCSS.seaborn(\"tab20\", levels=20)\r\n",
+      "        watersheds = []\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        for river_idx, river in enumerate(merged_rivers):\r\n",
+      "            # Collect all hexes that flow to this river\r\n",
+      "            basin_hexes = set(river.hexes)\r\n",
+      "            for hex_idx, assigned_river in hex_to_river.items():\r\n",
+      "                if assigned_river == river_idx:\r\n",
+      "                    basin_hexes.add(hex_idx)\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            region = HexRegion(hexes=basin_hexes, hexGrid=terrain.hexGrid)\r\n",
+      "            style = colors[river_idx % len(colors)]\r\n",
+      "            river.terrain = terrain\r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            \r\n",
+      "            watershed = cls(\r\n",
+      "                region=region,\r\n",
+      "                tributary=river,\r\n",
+      "                style=style\r\n",
+      "            )\r\n",
+      "            watersheds.append(watershed)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        if debug:\r\n",
+      "            print(f\"\\n=== STEP 4: Created {len(watersheds)} watersheds ===\")\r\n",
+      "            total_assigned = sum(len(w.region.hexes) for w in watersheds)\r\n",
+      "            total_land = sum(1 for e in terrain.elevations if e > 0)\r\n",
+      "            print(f\"  Total coverage: {total_assigned}/{total_land} land hexes ({100*total_assigned/total_land:.1f}%)\")\r\n",
+      "            for i, watershed in enumerate(watersheds):\r\n",
+      "                print(f\"  Watershed {i}: {len(watershed.region.hexes)} hexes, {watershed.tributary.terrain}\")\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        return watersheds\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
+      "    @staticmethod\r\n",
+      "    def decode(s: str, terrain: Terrain, system: SoilSystem = None) -> 'Watershed':\r\n",
+      "        \"\"\"Decode Watershed from string format.\"\"\"\r\n",
+      "        lines = s.strip().split('\\n')\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        style = None\r\n",
+      "        river_lines = []\r\n",
+      "        in_river = False\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        for line in lines:\r\n",
+      "            if in_river:\r\n",
+      "                if line.startswith('-river:'):\r\n",
+      "                    in_river = False\r\n",
+      "                else:\r\n",
+      "                    river_lines.append(line)\r\n",
+      "            elif line.startswith('style:'):\r\n",
+      "                style = StyleCSS.decode(line.split(':', 1)[1])\r\n",
+      "            elif line.startswith('+river:'):\r\n",
+      "                in_river = True\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Decode river\r\n",
+      "        river = River.decode('\\n'.join(river_lines), terrain)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        # Reconstruct region from river hexes\r\n",
+      "        region = HexRegion(hexes=river.hexes.copy(), hexGrid=terrain.hexGrid)\r\n",
+      "        \r\n",
+      "        return Watershed(region=region, tributary=river, style=style, system=system)\r\n",
+      "\r\n",
